jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description:
About this role 
 We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.
 The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered.
 A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on.
 Responsibilities 
 Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed.
 Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time.
 Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix.
 Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first-class requirements into the platform's abstractions.
 Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering.
 Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack.
 Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest-priority issues.
 Lead reliability cross-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage.
 Requirements 
 Experience operating a provisioning or host-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design.
 Deep experience owning production reliability for large-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus.
 Hands-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi-node training or disaggregated-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics.
 Familiarity with the operational realities of multi-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority.
 A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation.
 Hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node-level health/remediation systems.
 Comfort with event-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident.
 A software-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated.
 About Together AI 
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.
 Compensation 
 We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $160,000 - $280,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
 Equal Opportunity 
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
 Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy .

jobs.title: Engineer II, Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
 For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  
 Job's mission 
 We are seeking a skilled Engineer II, Electrical Engineering to support the electrical design, integration, qualification, and continuous improvement of process modules used in advanced semiconductor equipment. This role is responsible for developing safe, reliable, and manufacturable electrical solutions for process-module subsystems, including power distribution, controls, sensors, interlocks, safety circuits, cable assemblies, and system-level interfaces. The engineer will work closely with mechanical, process, controls, software, manufacturing, supply chain, and service teams to deliver robust module architectures that meet performance, safety, compliance, and productization requirements. 
 Responsibilities 
 Own the electrical design of process-module subsystems from concept through release, including schematics, cable drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnects, power distribution, sensors, heaters, actuators, safety circuits, and control interfaces. 
 Translate process, system, safety, serviceability, and manufacturability requirements into electrical design solutions that support reliable tool operation. 
 Collaborate with mechanical, process, controls, software, safety, manufacturing, service, and supply chain teams to develop integrated process-module architectures. 
 Select and qualify electrical components based on performance, safety, reliability, availability, environmental conditions, and lifecycle considerations. 
 Design and review safety-related electrical systems, including interlocks, emergency-off circuits, protective devices, grounding, bonding, and safety-rated components. 
 Develop, review, and release engineering documentation, including schematics, cable assemblies, bills of materials, design specifications, test plans, and ECO packages. 
 Support prototype builds, system integration, design verification, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for electrical issues found during development, qualification, manufacturing, or field escalation. 
 Work closely with designers and drafters to ensure electrical documentation is accurate, complete, and aligned with company standards and release processes. 
 Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, failure analysis, and continuous improvement activities to improve module reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability. 
 Maintain strong ownership of assigned tasks, manage priorities effectively, and communicate technical status, risks, and recommendations clearly to project stakeholders. 
 Required Qualifications and Skills 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 
 Experience designing and troubleshooting electrical systems for complex electromechanical equipment, preferably in semiconductor, vacuum, automation, industrial, or capital-equipment environments. 
 Strong understanding of electrical circuit design, power distribution, grounding, shielding, signal integrity, sensors, actuators, safety circuits, and cable assembly design. 
 Proficiency with electrical CAD tools for schematic capture and cable or harness design; AutoCAD Electrical or similar tools preferred. 
 Experience with component selection, design verification, prototype bring-up, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. 
 Working knowledge of applicable electrical safety and machinery standards such as NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, FM 4910, ISO 13849, EN/IEC 60204-1, EN/IEC 60204-33, and relevant SEMI standards is preferred. 
 Ability to create clear technical documentation, including specifications, test plans, design notes, ECO packages, and release documentation. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and quality teams. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, drive closure on technical issues, and make sound engineering decisions in a fast-paced product-development environment. 
 Familiarity with process-module hardware, pneumatics, PCB interfaces, embedded controls, PLC-based systems, or semiconductor equipment architecture is a plus.

We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

jobs.description:

We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  
 【会社概要】
 ASMはオランダに本社を置く、半導体製造装置業界のリーディングカンパニーです。特にALD（Atomic Layer Deposition）・Epitaxy・CVDといった「原子レベルの薄膜形成技術」において世界トップクラスのシェアを誇り、AI、2nm世代の先端ロジック半導体、3Dメモリなど、最先端半導体の量産を支えています。
 仕事内容：
 最先端の半導体製造を支えるフィールドエンジニアとして、顧客先工場にて装置の設置・立ち上げから保守、トラブル対応、アップグレードまで幅広く担当いただきます。装置の安定稼働を通じて、お客様の生産性向上に直接貢献できるポジションです。開発部門やグローバルチームとの連携機会も多く、高度な技術力と問題解決力を身につけることができます。
 【具体的には】
 ・半導体製造装置（ALD、Epitaxy、PECVD等）の設置、立ち上げおよび導入支援
 ・定期メンテナンスや装置点検の実施による安定稼働の維持
 ・装置トラブル発生時の原因解析、修理および復旧対応
 ・装置性能向上や生産性改善に向けたアップグレード、改造作業
 ・顧客からの技術的な問い合わせ対応および運用サポート
 ・本社・開発部門と連携した技術課題の解決およびフィードバック
 ・作業報告書やサービスレポートの作成
 ・安全基準や品質基準に基づくフィールドサービス業務の遂行
 ・オンコール対応および緊急時のサポート対応（必要に応じて）
 応募資格：
 【必須（MUST）】
 ■高卒以上の学歴
 ■日本語：流暢
 ■英語：読み書きレベル以上（書類は英語になります。）
 ■２年以上のフィールドサービスの経験（大型装置、大型機械の経験、開発経験者も含む）
 【歓迎（WANT）】
 ■半導体の知識
 ■理工系学部の専攻者
 【ASM Japanの魅力】
 ASM Japanは、オランダ本社ASM Internationalの重要な研究開発拠点です。
 日本がグローバルR&Dの中核拠点となっており、PEALD・PECVDを中心としたプラズマ成膜技術の開発をリードし、世界中の半導体メーカー向け製品の開発に携わっています。
 東京（多摩）・神奈川（川崎）を中心とした7つの戦略拠点を展開。
 装置開発だけでなく、製品プラットフォーム設計やソフトウェア開発も日本チームが担当しており、日本発の技術が世界で採用されています。
 また、外資系では珍しく日本での研究開発は1982年にスタート。
 外資系企業でありながら40年以上にわたり日本で研究開発を継続しており、日本の技術者が中心となって製品開発を推進しています。
 現在では約30％の社員が外国籍で、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーと協働しており、グローバルな環境で成長できます。
 日常的に英語を活用する機会があり、海外拠点との共同開発や海外勤務・海外出張のチャンスも豊富です。

This role partners closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, and other cross-functional teams, leveraging advanced CAD, PLM, and Model-Based Engineering methodologies to identify, analyze, and resolve design, integration, and manufacturability challenges early in the development process.  Clash and interference analysis

 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 Advanced ability with CAD/DMU platforms such as Siemens NX, PTC Creo, and associated PLM systems.   
 Strong knowledge and practical experience in:    
 Mechanical system design and integration   
 Product development processes   
 Configuration and BOM management   
 Manufacturing operations and readiness   
 Product packaging and accessory integration   
 Assembly, installation, and validation methodologies   
 Serviceability, maintainability, and lifecycle support planning   
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.   
 Experience applying Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) methodologies to product development and process improvement initiatives.   
 Expert knowledge of ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards with a minimum of seven years of practical application.

 Working knowledge in Configuration Management (CMII) and enterprise change management practices.

 Reducing engineering rework, development costs, prototype dependency, and program risk.

 ASMはオランダに本社を置く、半導体製造装置業界のリーディングカンパニーです。特にALD（Atomic Layer Deposition）・Epitaxy・CVDといった「原子レベルの薄膜形成技術」において世界トップクラスのシェアを誇り、AI、2nm世代の先端ロジック半導体、3Dメモリなど、最先端半導体の量産を支えています。
 仕事内容：
 最先端の半導体製造を支えるフィールドエンジニアとして、顧客先工場にて装置の設置・立ち上げから保守、トラブル対応、アップグレードまで幅広く担当いただきます。装置の安定稼働を通じて、お客様の生産性向上に直接貢献できるポジションです。開発部門やグローバルチームとの連携機会も多く、高度な技術力と問題解決力を身につけることができます。
 【具体的には】
 ・半導体製造装置（ALD、Epitaxy、PECVD等）の設置、立ち上げおよび導入支援
 ・定期メンテナンスや装置点検の実施による安定稼働の維持
 ・装置トラブル発生時の原因解析、修理および復旧対応
 ・装置性能向上や生産性改善に向けたアップグレード、改造作業
 ・顧客からの技術的な問い合わせ対応および運用サポート
 ・本社・開発部門と連携した技術課題の解決およびフィードバック

 ・安全基準や品質基準に基づくフィールドサービス業務の遂行
 ・オンコール対応および緊急時のサポート対応（必要に応じて）
 応募資格：
 【必須（MUST）】
 ■学士以上の学歴
 ■日本語：流暢
 ■英語：読み書きレベル以上（書類は英語になります。）
 ■２年以上のフィールドサービスの経験（大型装置、大型機械の経験、開発経験者も含む）
 【歓迎（WANT）】
 ■半導体の知識
 ■理工系学部の専攻者
 【ASM Japanの魅力】
 ASM Japanは、オランダ本社ASM Internationalの重要な研究開発拠点です。
 日本がグローバルR&Dの中核拠点となっており、PEALD・PECVDを中心としたプラズマ成膜技術の開発をリードし、世界中の半導体メーカー向け製品の開発に携わっています。
 東京（多摩）・神奈川（川崎）を中心とした7つの戦略拠点を展開。
 装置開発だけでなく、製品プラットフォーム設計やソフトウェア開発も日本チームが担当しており、日本発の技術が世界で採用されています。

You will own the local mechanical design roadmap, solving complex challenges in heat transfer, motion and vibration, cantilever loading, and fluid and thermal dynamics while driving reliability and yield for our customers. By combining deep technical leadership with strong people management and customer collaboration, you will help translate ASM's vision and strategy into robust tools and solutions that keep fabs running at the cutting edge.
 What you will be working on 
 Lead a small team of mechanical engineers, setting and communicating clear goals, priorities, and expectations that align with ASM's vision, strategy, and long-term objectives.
 Own the mechanical design roadmap for the local platform, from concept through validation, ensuring robust equipment designs that meet performance, reliability, safety, and cost targets.
 Design and analyze critical mechanical subsystems, including heat transfer, motion and vibration, cantilever loads, and fluid/thermal dynamics, using appropriate analytical and simulation tools.
 Interface closely with robotics, vacuum, and other subsystem teams to deliver integrated equipment solutions that meet system-level requirements.
 Incorporate customer insights and market trends into mechanical design and platform planning, adapting goals to stay ahead of industry developments.
 Lead incident investigations on mechanical and cross-module issues, verify corrective actions region-wide, and ensure sustainable closure of technical problems.
 Troubleshoot cross-module yield excursions in collaboration with integration and process teams, and mentor junior engineers on integration and mechanical risk.

 Facilitate structured RCCA (root cause and corrective action) processes, embedding systemic fixes, tracking KPI improvements, and driving a culture of continuous improvement.
 Design and analyze complex DOEs (design of experiments); apply multivariate analysis and PCA to isolate key factors, optimize designs, and understand interactions across subsystems.
 Present technical status, risks, and mitigation plans in customer QBRs and other reviews, and coordinate rapid cross-functional response actions when issues arise.
 Encourage and support the sharing of new ideas, creating a culture where innovation is welcomed, constructive challenge is embraced, and ideas are acted upon.
 Drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring diverse perspectives are included in decisions that move the organization forward and shape future initiatives.
 Champion consistent delivery of high-quality work by reinforcing best practices, critical thinking, and risk management, while identifying and driving improvements to team processes.
 Support the growth and development of team members through regular feedback, coaching, and mentoring, role modeling openness to feedback and continuous self-improvement.
 Create a culture of learning by encouraging skill development, offering opportunities for growth, and promoting a growth mindset that sees change as an opportunity for innovation.
 Empower others by delegating responsibility effectively and fostering autonomy in decision-making, while holding the team accountable for meeting commitments and safety standards.
 Foster an inclusive, positive team culture where people feel valued, respected, and motivated, helping to attract, retain, and inspire top talent.
 Model resilience and a solution-focused mindset during change, clearly communicating changes and how they align with organizational goals and the One ASM mindset.
 Drive collaboration across teams and regions to ensure a unified, cross-functional response to organizational and customer-driven changes.
 What we are looking for 
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field with 12+ years of relevant industry experience; or
Master's degree with 8+ years of experience; or
PhD with 4+ years of experience.
 2-3 years of people managing experience.
 Proven experience in equipment or complex machinery design, ideally in semiconductor capital equipment or closely related high-tech industries.
 Demonstrated experience managing and developing small engineering teams, including setting direction, assigning work, and leading performance and development discussions.
 Strong technical foundation in heat transfer, structural mechanics (including motion, vibration, and cantilever loads), and fluid and thermal dynamics.
 Experience leading technical incident investigations and driving corrective and preventive actions through structured RCCA methodologies.
 Familiarity with defining and applying control limits, and with auditing or improving measurement systems to ensure data quality and repeatability.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (such as process, integration, software, controls, manufacturing, and service) and to build strong partnerships with stakeholders.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mechanical and system-level topics clearly in English, both in writing and in person, including to customers when needed.
 A clear commitment to safety, quality, inclusion, and to building a team culture based on accountability, learning, and mutual respect.
 What sets you apart 
 Direct experience in mechanical engineering for semiconductor process tools, vacuum systems, robotics, or other advanced capital equipment.
 Hands-on experience troubleshooting cross-module yield excursions and working with integration and process teams in a fab or equipment environment.
 Experience defining site control limits and auditing measurement capability at both customer and internal manufacturing or test sites.

jobs.title: Leasing Consultant - McDowell Point 55+
jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR 
 Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com .
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
The Leasing / Sales Consultant is responsible for executing the property’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals. This role serves as a key point of contact for prospective residents, guiding them through the leasing process with professionalism and a deep understanding of the community’s lifestyle offering. The Sales Consultant supports resident satisfaction throughout the lease term and proactively manages lease renewals in alignment with Active Adult best practices. Responsibilities include lead management, CRM utilization, data analysis, event support, and collaboration with the Lifestyle Coordinator to enhance resident engagement. The Sales Consultant upholds Greystar’s professional standards and ethical expectations while delivering exceptional service to residents, prospects, and guests. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.    Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the property’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting property tours and showing apartments, continuing the relationship with prospects, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
2.    Collects all pertinent information from prospective residents at move-in and records as appropriate.
3.    Stays informed about and collaborates with teams/leadership on current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy, market rent, and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the property’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy. 
4.    Designs and executes marketing activities and events to create and drive traffic to the property, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools and following other property-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
5.    Uses the on-site property management software application to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents, and review and analyze data. 
6.    Ensures that the property and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the tour path and show ready units, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the property’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities. 
 7.    Follows-up with prospects and new residents within 24 hours to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew. Documents all follow up and classes leads during the lifecycle of the sales process.
8.    Executes and performs activities in support of the property’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time, following the AA renewal playbook. 
9.    Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).
10.    Demonstrates customer services skills by treating residents, prospects, guests, and others with respect, answering questions, and responding sensitively to complaints about maintenance services. Interacts with all residents and acknowledges them by name. 
11.    Attends community and networking events, aligns with local associations and community organizations, and participates in outreach marketing efforts to drive traffic to community and generate viable referral sources and new business leads, ensuring Greystar AA outreach expectations are consistently met. 
12.    Completes various financial, administrative, and other reports and analysis, and performs other duties as assigned or necessary.
13.    Assists Lifestyle Coordinator by attending and assisting with the setup of events as required.
 BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS: 
•    High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, hospitality, or related field preferred.
•    1-3 years minimum of relevant experience in the application and usage of a sales, marketing, internet and customer service background sufficient to resolve customer complaints and issues and complete financial records, documents, and reports.
•    Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively to comprehend and complete legal documents, sell and explain apartment features, and answer questions. 
 •    Mathematical skills necessary to process sales conversions.
 •    Ability to apply sales skills, such as generating sales leads, conducting sales presentations, qualifying prospects, and closing.
 SPECIALIZED SKILLS: 
•    Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
 •    Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
 •    Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, property management applications, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents. 
 •    Proficiency and fluency in using the internet for marketing, advertising, and sales-related circumstances.
 •    Ability to adapt to specific markets and professionals to ensure your sales message is received appropriately. 
 TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS: 
•    Team members work in an office environment but also may have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperature, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous. 
•    Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior and interior parts of the property and amenities. 
•    Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance and be able to stand for extended periods of time.
•    Routine, local travel may be required to attend business meetings, conduct market research, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.

11.    Attends community and networking events, aligns with local associations and community organizations, and participates in outreach marketing efforts to drive traffic to community and generate viable referral sources and new business leads, ensuring Greystar AA outreach expectations are consistently met.

13.    Assists Lifestyle Coordinator by attending and assisting with the setup of events as required.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR 
 Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com .
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
We are seeking an analytically strong Corporate FP&A Analyst to support Greystar’s C-Suite functions, including the Offices of the CEO (Chief Executive Officer), CFO (Chief Financial Officer), CIO (Chief Investment Officer), and CLO (Chief Legal Officer). The functions supported include, but are not limited to, Managed Capital, Investment Strategy & Research, Data & Technology, Legal, Risk Management, Treasury, and Tax. The Corporate FP&A team supports 40+ business leaders across these functions. 
Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate FP&A, this individual will support the operating expense forecasts for each of these functions, including the annual business plan as well as monthly and quarterly forecasts, and prepare the consolidated reporting and analysis used to explain financial performance to senior leaders. The Analyst also supports cost allocation reporting for the C-Suite functions and will serve as a hands-on driver of the team’s use of AI, automation, and the systems tech stack. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 C-Suite Operating Expense Planning & Forecasting 
 Own operating expense (OpEx) and capital expense (CapEx) budgeting, forecasting, and variance tracking packages for each C-Suite function, partnering with function leaders to build forecasts that are well-supported and defensible.
 Own budget-to-actual variance explanations for monthly reporting deliverables, partnering with Accounting, Finance and function leaders to identify key drivers and provide clear, timely commentary.
 Prepare the annual business plan, quarterly reforecasts, and related presentation materials for senior leadership for the C-Suite functions, collaborating with Accounting, Finance, and business teams to collect, validate, and synthesize inputs.
 Perform ad hoc reporting and analytics, including what-if and scenario analyses, in response to requests from the CFO, CLO, CIO, and their leadership teams.
 Consolidated C-Suite Reporting & Analysis 
 Prepare each consolidated C-Suite management reporting package for senior leadership, pairing the numbers with a clear narrative — key drivers identified, variances explained, and leadership questions anticipated before they’re asked.
 Analyze monthly and quarterly financial performance for each C-Suite function against budget and forecast, identify key drivers and variances, investigate unexpected results, and communicate meaningful insights to Corporate Finance and senior leadership.
 Review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before distribution, and take ownership of assigned deliverables from initial request through completion.
 Cost Allocation Ownership & Reporting 
 Partner with the functional leaders to understand the cost drivers across the C-Suite functions and help shape allocation methodologies that distribute those costs across the businesses, balancing accuracy, fairness, and practicality.
 Own the ongoing validation process that confirms allocated costs are posted correctly across every ledger in scope, maintaining clear documentation of how the process works.
 Assist in delivering proactive allocation variance summaries each financial review cycle, and document the reasoning behind the allocation methodology and any changes made during the year.
 Systems, Automation & AI-Driven Analysis 
 Serve as a hands-on driver of the team’s FP&A tech stack, using Anaplan, Claude, and Microsoft 365 (Copilot, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and related tools) as the core toolset for daily work.
 Actively participate in and advocate for the Anaplan roadmap on behalf of the C-Suite functions, and represent the team in relevant systems and technology planning forums.
 Identify and implement process and procedural improvements that streamline recurring work, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve the quality of financial reporting.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Exposure 
 Build and maintain proactive working relationships with the finance and operations leaders across the C-Suite functions.
 Partner regularly with Accounting, Corporate Finance, and the business-line FP&A teams to ensure cohesive, well-reconciled reporting across teams.
 BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS 
 Required: 
 Strong analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives. The successful candidate must also be adaptable and responsive to evolving business needs.
 Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or another quantitative discipline required.
 1-2 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or financial analysis.
 Solid understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.
 Demonstrated ability to interpret financial information and communicate insights clearly and concisely to senior leadership.
 Exceptional attention to detail, with a high degree of initiative and ownership and the ability to move work forward independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
 Resourceful problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguity, investigate questions, and develop solutions without requiring step-by-step instructions.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.
 Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively, anticipate needs, ask thoughtful questions, and escalate issues appropriately.
 Collaborative and dependable team member who is equally comfortable working independently and partnering across functions.
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
 Preferred: 
 MBA, CFA, or CPA designation preferred.
 Experience with Anaplan or a comparable FP&A planning tool is preferred but not required; candidates should be willing and able to learn the platform.
 Experience using generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude, to enhance analytical and reporting workflows.
 Experience supporting corporate or shared services functions, or working with cost allocation methodologies, is preferred but not required.
 Experience in real estate or investment management is preferred but not required.

 Please review the following job description: 
Supports implementation of Enterprise Data Management and Governance Policy requirements, specifically data retention and disposition, across the enterprise, enabling business growth while ensuring compliance with risk and regulatory expectations. The position primarily reviews the execution of data retention and disposition efforts with various business and technology stakeholders. The position is also responsible for ensuring Truist’s compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
 Support the implementation of data governance policies, standards and technology.  
 Execute processes and procedures to support data standards and control frameworks.
 Perform quality reviews of data retention and disposition activities by business units for adherence to established data policies and control frameworks. 
 Coordinate with Assist in data governance efforts that span across platforms and business/technology areas to address enterprise data needs.
 Support Implementation of strategic data governance capabilities by working with business and technology partners to document requirements and create action plans.
 Maintain awareness of relevant regulations, industry trends and emerging technologies.
 Support the production of metrics to track progress and adherence, escalating as needed to various committees for visibility and program accountability.
 Collaborate closely with peer teams to ensure coordination, synergy and seamless overall execution.
 Identify and advocate for improvements in enterprise data management practices.
 Implements and executes on technical initiatives and solutions.
 Adheres to developing AI and data governance standards aligned with organizational goals.
 Makes adjustments or recommend enhancements in technical systems and processes to solve somewhat complex technical problems or improve effectiveness of area of responsibility.
 Works with technical project teams to provide accurate documentation of data related to project and deliverables.
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent education, training, and work-related experience.
 Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in AI and data.
 Understanding of AI models, data architectures, and analytics methodologies.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline.
 Banking or financial services experience, especially within data or technology. 
 Experience with lifecycle management and/or records management 
 Experience working in RSA Archer  
 Understanding of regulatory compliance and data governance frameworks.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 The ability to follow a project through to completion, and to work as part of a larger team to complete the components of a complex project.
 To comply with the Virginia pay transparency statute and for work locations in Virginia only, the annual base salary for this position is $88,000 - $105,000.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Project Role : Business Analyst
 Project Role Description : Analyze an organization and design its processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information.
 Must have skills : Openlink Endur Functional
 Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
 Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
Summary: 
As a Business Analyst, a typical day involves thoroughly examining the organization's structure and workflows to understand how business processes align with technological systems. jobs.description:
YOU ARE  
 As a hands on AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of designing and building the components that make up advanced AI systems powering the modern enterprise. This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role — you will spend the majority of your time in the detailed design, development, integration, and testing of AI system components across classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems, delivering these within active client engagements.    You will take detailed architecture and design specifications and translate them into working, production-quality software components. This means writing clean, well-structured code, making low-level design decisions within your assigned scope, and ensuring your components integrate reliably within the broader AI system. You will build and wire together the constituent parts of AI agent systems — including individual agent logic, tool integrations, skills, and memory components — and contribute to the development and integration of foundation and classical ML models into end-to-end pipelines.    A hands-on curiosity for the open source ecosystem is essential in this role. You will continuously evaluate, learn, and adopt relevant open source libraries and frameworks — such as those spanning agent orchestration, vector storage, model serving, and ML pipelines — selecting and applying the right ones for the problem at hand. Equally, you will configure, integrate, and operationalize third-party AI technologies and platform services, understanding their capabilities and constraints deeply enough to make them work reliably within the context of a larger enterprise system.    You will engineer components with enterprise-grade qualities in mind, ensuring your work meets defined requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. You will write and maintain the technical artifacts that accompany your engineering work — including low-level design documents, component specifications, and integration contracts — ensuring your work is well-documented, testable, and handoff-ready.    You will operate as a practitioner within cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, taking direction from lead and principal architects while contributing meaningfully to technical problem-solving and design discussions within your domain.    This role is an opportunity to build deep, hands-on expertise across the AI engineering stack, develop strong software engineering fundamentals applied to cutting-edge AI systems, and grow toward a lead engineer or architect role over time. 
 THE WORK  
 Design, build, and configure individual agents — including their prompts, tools, and skills — and integrate them into multi-agent workflows 
 Implement agent orchestration logic that handles task handoffs, communication, and error recovery 
 Build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure agent and component quality on metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, and share findings to inform design improvements 
 Integrate foundation models into applications, selecting the appropriate model and invocation pattern for each use case 
 Build and run model fine-tuning pipelines — including data preparation and training — to adapt models to specific business domains, applying working knowledge of transformer-based architectures 
 Build ingestion pipelines that parse, chunk, enrich, and index unstructured enterprise content for retrieval 
 Implement embedding generation, integrate vector databases, and develop retrieval components, including connectors and adapters that process unstructured content into end-to-end RAG pipelines 
 Build the logic that assembles prompts and manages what information is passed to the model within its context window 
 Implement memory components that store and recall conversational history and other relevant context 
 Implement input/output guardrails, content filtering, and defenses against prompt injection 
 Build PII detection and redaction components and integrate access controls for model and tool access 
 Implement versioning, audit logging, and lineage tracking, and maintain model documentation that keeps the system auditable 
 Instrument components with logging and tracing for requests, responses, token usage, and tool calls 
 Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and cost tracking that keep AI systems healthy in production 
 Continuously learn and apply new design patterns, technologies, and frameworks across the fast-evolving AI landscape, bringing fresh approaches to the components you build 
 Collaborate within cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and ensure your components meet stakeholder needs 
 Create and maintain clear technical documentation for the components you build, supporting troubleshooting and future development 
 EDUCATION  
 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science,  Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline 
 BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION  
 Experience (work or coursework) in designing, coding, building advanced AI solutions using agentic, generative and classical AI/ML using at least one cloud vendor. 
 Experience (work or coursework in the Agentic, LLM and Generative AI space. 
 Experience (work or coursework) architecting and operationalizing LLM driven application architecture patterns. 
 Proficiency with coding and engineering, machine learning, deep learning and NLP solutions and applications. 
 Coding experience using python 
 What We Offer
 Access to cutting-edge AI, agentic AI, and generative AI projects for leading global organisations
 Continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and training across cloud, AI, and emerging technologies
 Flexible working models that support the way you work best
 International collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and leading AI experts
 Clear career development opportunities towards Lead Engineer, AI Architect, or Principal Architect roles
 The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change
 Your unique combination of skills, personality, and aspirations sets you apart. When distinct talents, strengths, and perspectives merge, the result is nothing short of extraordinary: ideas that propel the world forward. jobs.description:
Core Responsibilities 
 Serve as a senior technical leader for traditional and agentic AI/ML capabilities supporting enterprise conversational AI across voice, chat, and emerging agentic experiences while providing technical direction and guiding complex solutions from design through production.
 Drive Data Science across the full AI lifecycle, from problem formulation, research and experimentation through solution design, development, evaluation, deployment readiness, production measurement, and continuous optimization.
 Lead development and optimization of traditional and agentic AI/ML solutions, including supervised and unsupervised learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLM-based applications, agentic systems, classification models, and knowledge/retrieval-based solutions.
 Advance evaluation and production intelligence for conversational AI, establishing rigorous methods to assess functional accuracy, user-need fulfillment, reliability, and other system-level behaviors.
 Develop scalable evaluation approaches that enable teams to identify failure modes, compare solutions, establish benchmarks, and make evidence-based release decisions. 
 Apply strong analytical and statistical thinking to uncover patterns in large and complex datasets, diagnose model and system behavior, perform root-cause analysis, design experiments, quantify uncertainty, and translate findings into actionable product and engineering recommendations.
 Turn complex data into clear, cohesive stories and actionable insights, combining exploratory analysis, visualization, statistical reasoning, and business context to deliver diagnostic metrics and product improvements.
 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Analytics, Risk and other stakeholders as an embedded technical leader, translating ambiguous business and client problems into measurable Data Science problems and scalable AI solutions
 Establish technical standards and best practices for model development, experimentation, evaluation, validation, observability, explainability, documentation, and responsible use of AI.
 Drive continuous improvement of conversational and agentic systems by converting evaluation and production signals into hypotheses, experiments, model/prompt/system improvements, and measurable outcomes.
 Communicate complex AI/ML concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence decisions across cross-functional teams.
 Stay current with advances in AI and Data Science and evaluate emerging methods, models, frameworks, and architectures.
 Qualifications 
 10+ years of relevant Data Science, Machine Learning, or applied AI experience, with demonstrated experience leading complex technical work; prior people leadership or technical team leadership strongly preferred. 
 Strong practical foundation in machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model development, validation, experimentation, and performance measurement.
 Demonstrated expertise in Natural Language Processing and Generative AI, with a strong understanding of transformer architectures, embeddings, LLMs, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and modern language-model development patterns.
 Hands-on experience designing, building, evaluating, or optimizing agentic AI systems, including areas such as orchestration/routing, tool use, knowledge retrieval, multi-turn conversational behavior, and agent evaluation.
 Strong Python and data-analysis skills, with experience working with large datasets and using modern ML/Data Science libraries and development environments.
 Experience with AI/ML evaluation and observability, including developing evaluation datasets, metrics, benchmarks, automated evaluations, production monitoring, failure analysis, and methods for connecting model/system behavior to client or business outcomes.
 Ability to move comfortably between technical depth and business context, translating loosely defined problems into hypotheses, analytical approaches, measurable success criteria, and actionable recommendations.
 Demonstrated ability to lead and develop Data Scientists, provide thoughtful technical review, establish engineering and modeling standards, manage competing priorities, and create an environment of accountability, learning, and experimentation.
 Strong data analytics, visualization, and storytelling skills to turn complex data into actionable insights.
 Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts and influence Product, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, Risk, and senior business stakeholders.
 Education 
 Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Advanced degree preferred. 
 Special Factors 
 Sponsorship 
Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. 
 About Vanguard 
 At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.
 To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.
 How We Work 
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

 Experience leading sales teams specifically within Cloud Security or Hyperscaler ecosystems.

 Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
 About the Team
 We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable , Discoverable , and Callable for autonomous AI agents.
 Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet . As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.
 We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
 About the Role
 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our Agentic Discovery portfolio.
 You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind customer-facing products that help businesses manage how AI agents understand, represent, and interact with their digital properties. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to shape priorities around Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), content ingestion/indexing, agent observation and testing tools, and open tool-execution standards (such as WebMCP and Generative UI).
 This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around distributed systems and web-scale data pipelines, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.
 At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.
 This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.
 What you'll do
 Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across customer-facing Agentic Discovery products, AEO tooling, and agent-web interaction standards.
 Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
 Lead the development of tools enabling Cloudflare customers to make their content Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing, directories, and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.
 Build tools for customers to test, observe, measure, and control how AI agents find and interact with their websites and applications.
 Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
 Identify how Cloudflare's global network and edge signals can enable unique products that help businesses reach trusted agentic audiences at scale.
 Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
 Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data quality, and long-term reliability.
 Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.
 Responsibilities
 We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:
 You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
 You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or web-scale data pipelines, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.
 You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (such as search/indexing, protocol standards, and UI engineering) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.
 You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that users and AI agents rely on to navigate the Internet.
 You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement, and what should not be built at all.
 You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
 You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.
 Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
 Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web-scale data platforms, agentic architectures, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.
 Experience building customer-facing products involving content indexing, crawling, analytics, or complex user interaction patterns.
 Experience operating systems where correctness, data quality, and reliability matter as much as feature delivery.
 A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
 Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
 Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
 Strong written and verbal communication.
 Bonus Points
 Hands-on familiarity with emerging agentic technologies and standards such as WebMCP, AEO, and Generative UI.
 Experience building products for AI developers, AI agents, publishers, or content-heavy websites.

 About The Role

 What You'll Do 
 Support and assist in the end to end server product qualification from concept to deployment, ensuring hardware designs (electrical, thermal and mechanical) are optimized for seamless, large-scale implementation by the Infrastructure Operations team.

 Cloudflare’s Product Management team defines the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the features that power this massive global footprint.  The ideal Product Manager Intern is curious, user-focused, and passionate about making the Internet a better place. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are proactive, analytical, and eager to drive projects from concept to launch. This is a unique opportunity for aspiring PMs to learn how to manage and scale products at Internet scale.
 You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.
 Responsibilities

 Define the Future: Conduct user research and competitive analysis to understand user needs and market trends. You will identify pain points and uncover opportunities to make our tools best-in-class.
 Collaborate to Build: Work hand-in-hand with engineering, design, and product leaders to bring your vision to life, ensuring features are built to spec, meet user expectations, and solve hard technical problems at scale.
 Drive for Impact: Help define success metrics and ensure the features you launch are not only technically sound, but also drive measurable business value and solve real-world problems for our users.
 Solve Complex Problems: Proactively analyze challenges, balance technical feasibility with user needs, and turn market constraints into opportunities for innovation and growth.
 Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 
 Currently pursuing a degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
 A strong passion for technology and a deep empathy for user needs.
 Technical literacy, with the ability to understand architectural concepts and empathize with developer workflows.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and takes initiative.
 Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week) 12-week internship.
 In-office expectation of 3–5 days per week in Austin, TX.
 Bonus Points: 
 Familiarity with networking, security, or Zero Trust concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS).
 Hands-on experience with developer tools, APIs, or personal projects using Cloudflare products (such as Cloudflare for Students ).
 Previous experience writing product specifications, building wireframes, or conducting user research.
 Basic coding ability or familiarity with command-line tools and developer workflows.
 Please Note: 
 We hire interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.
 We are not considering remote or part-time applicants. This is a full-time (40 hours/week) internship with in-person expectations during standard business hours (typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM). You should not be enrolled in conflicting classes during the internship term.
 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 
 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. 
 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 
 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 
 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
 Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
 Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
 Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. 
 AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
 Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).
 Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
 Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
 Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
 Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

 Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
 Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
 Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.
 AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.
 Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.
 Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructu

About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: Singapore
 About the Department 
 The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.
 The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.
 About This Role 
 In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of commercial accounts in the Philippines market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.
 You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.
 Role Responsibilities 
 Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.
 Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  
 Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.
 Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.
 Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.
 Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.
 Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).
 Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. 
 Required Experience 
 Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
 Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.
 Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.
 Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.
 Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.
 Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.
 Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).
 Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.
 Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.
 Ability to travel as required.
 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 
 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. 
 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 
 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 
 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! 
 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. 
 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

ronment and maintain a strong focus on execution across multiple priorities. You’ll think like a client by using data to understand customer needs, act like an owner by taking accountability for commercial outcomes, and win as one team by helping stakeholders turn insight into action.
