 Title and Summary 
Associate Consultant (Marketing), Launch Graduate Program 2027 – Athens, Greece  
Associate Consultant, Launch Program – 2027- Athens, Greece
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program? 
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact. 
Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard. 
About the team 
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities. 
What you’ll do 
As an Associate Consultant, you will: 
collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions.  
create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more. 
Specialization Tracks 
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. 
Marketing 
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard. 
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer: 
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications? 
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer? 
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more? 
Team members typically support 1-3 projects from any domain and build fundamental marketing and consulting toolkit. 
What we’re looking for 
Undergraduate or master's degree with graduation completed maximum before September 2027. 
Eligibility to work 
Language Proficiency:
Proficiency in English is mandatory
We recruit for and value the following core competencies: 
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities. 
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks). 
Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions. 
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities. 
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude. 
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes. 
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity. 
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Business & Market Insights (B&MI) team within Mastercard's Services division creates products that help customers including financial institutions and merchants understand their customers and the market better. The B&MI Data Science team uses data from Mastercard transactions and other sources to build models and solutions that are needed for these products, at a globally scalable level across the different customer lifecycle stages.
This role is for a Data Scientist that will work across Product, Client Services & Delivery, Data & Engineering and the broader teams, to deliver truly differentiated products driven by analytics & AI, leveraging rich data resources, AI platform capabilities and near real-time execution.
We are developing multiple new products and capabilities using analytics & AI, and this role is central in that vision, from concept, technical design to market release and optimization. - Design, develop, and productionize machine learning and data science solutions that solve complex business problems within BMI.

- Perform exploratory data analysis and translate complex datasets into actionable insights.
- Optimize data pipelines and ML workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.
- Develop robust and reusable Python components following sound software-engineering practices.
- Use PySpark to process, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently in distributed environments.
- Write advanced, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, feature development, and analytical workloads.
- Apply appropriate controls for data privacy, security, responsible AI, monitoring, and explainability.
Good to have:

The successful candidate’s primary responsibilities will be to:

- Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development
- Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development
- Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations

- Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders

Coordinates work with Credit, Loan Administration and other groups, promoting consistent quality and conciseness of credit documents and streamlining workflow among underwriting, credit approval and loan administration.
 Underwriting & Credit Analysis 
 Underwrite new originations and portfolio exposures for a broad range of CRE asset classes. 
 Analyze borrower financials, property cash flows, collateral valuation, sponsor strength, covenant sensitivities, and market conditions
 Prepare clear, comprehensive written credit analyses and supporting documentation
 Execute straightforward credit requests for existing clients with limited supervision
 Assist with annual company‑wide credit reviews for clients with multiple property holdings, including analysis beyond bank‑financed properties
 Transaction & Deal Support 
 Support both existing property transactions (including refinancings) and ground‑up construction projects, including budget monitoring and monthly construction draw reviews through project completion
 Assist with new deal originations, evaluating opportunities with typical transaction sizes of $50MM–$100MM, with select transactions up to $750MM
 Participate in the preparation and negotiation of term sheets, as applicable
 Portfolio Management & Credit Monitoring 
 Support Relationship Managers and Portfolio Managers in managing an assigned portfolio of commercial real estate client relationships
 Perform accurate and consistent spreading of borrower financial statements in accordance with bank standards and credit policies
 Prepare quarterly trend analyses, monitoring reports, and covenant compliance testing
 Maintain compliance monitoring and financial reporting databases, including tracking credit agreement requirements, borrower financial receipt, and key credit metrics
 Participate in quarterly portfolio reviews, including analysis of operating statements, rent rolls, and risk assessments
 Proactively identify and communicate emerging risks, mitigants, and other issues at the transaction and portfolio level
 Collaboration & Communication 
 Collaborate effectively with Credit Approvers and internal risk partners
 Participate in client bank meetings, as needed, to support underwriting, portfolio management, and risk discussions
 Serve as a reliable first line of credit analysis, escalating issues appropriately
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
 Five or more years of commercial lending experience
 Preferred Skills/Experience 
 Strong foundation in CRE underwriting across multiple property types (cash flow, valuation, sponsor analysis, structure, and covenants). 
 Experience authoring credit memoranda and presenting key risks, mitigants, and recommendations to approval committees
 Strong analytical and technical writing skills; able to translate complex sponsor/tenant/technical diligence into clear credit narratives
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across origination, portfolio management, credit risk, and technical advisors
 Comfort operating with accountability—independently driving analyses while partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Portfolio Managers, and Credit Approvers
 Familiarity with banking credit policy, loan documentation concepts, and CRE underwriting processes (construction, bridge, term, and portfolio facilities)

 Your role and impact 
 The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm. 
 This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together. 
 Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder. 
 Your responsibilities 
 In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 
 Take ownership of complex, ambiguous business problems and rapidly translate them into testable solution hypotheses with measurable outcomes. 
 Build structured business context covering terminology, entities, relationships, decision logic, data dependencies, controls and exceptions for use by subject matter experts, AI tools and engineering teams. 
 Decompose business processes into explicit logic, controls and exception paths for implementation by technology teams. 
 Create functional prototypes using AI-enabled development capabilities to discover requirements, challenge assumptions and validate future-state processes, data, policies and controls. 
 Shape the target operating model, including ownership of data, governance, controls, roles and exception management. 
 Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation. 
 Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels. 
 Your experience 
 3–5 years of relevant work experience in transformation, product delivery, business architecture, technology-enabled change or a comparable discipline. 
 Experience in business architecture and operating-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling. 
 Proficiency in prototype-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge. 
 Expertise using AI-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential. 
 Experience with iterative delivery and hands-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping. 
 Experience in financial services or a similar industry. 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate objectives and influence outcomes. 
 Our benefits 
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
 Our hybrid work model 
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates 
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance  on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
 About BlackRock 
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok .
 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

 What you’ll do
 As a Corporate Security Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead the security infrastructure workstream for new offices, expansions, relocations, and major workplace upgrades, with an initial focus on Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) and support for global projects as needed. You will manage projects from early site assessment and design through installation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
 You will be accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of concurrent projects. In addition to delivering individual projects, you will strengthen the CSI program by improving standards, documentation, vendor performance, reporting, and repeatable project management processes. You will work through ambiguity, surface decisions early, and communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.
 Responsibilities
 Lead end-to-end delivery of security infrastructure for office construction and expansion projects, from site assessment and requirements definition through design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
 Lead requests for proposals (RFPs) for security installations, including defining scope and requirements, coordinating bidders, reviewing submissions, evaluating proposals with relevant stakeholders, and supporting vendor selection recommendations.
 Own project scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, decisions, and change control; provide clear, outcome-focused reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
 Coordinate security designs and technical requirements with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, architects, general contractors, landlords, and other project partners.
 Review design drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and implementation plans to ensure alignment with CSI standards and local requirements.
 Manage security integrators, consultants, and contractors, including statements of work, delivery milestones, quality expectations, service levels, and performance reviews.
 Oversee system installation, acceptance testing, commissioning, punch-list resolution, documentation, and first-day-of-business readiness.
 Ensure completed projects are smoothly handed over to the GSOC and support teams, with accurate system records, operating procedures, training, and ownership established.
 Maintain and improve global construction standards, technical specifications, project templates, runbooks, and closeout documentation.
 Develop and track project health metrics, vendor KPIs, budget forecasts, and lessons learned; use insights to improve delivery quality, predictability, and cost efficiency.
 Support new market and site evaluations by identifying security risks, infrastructure constraints, integration needs, and mitigation options.
 Support the security repair and maintenance program, with a focus on the EMEA region, collaborating with regional teams to triage, track, and resolve security system and hardware issues.
 Partner with CSI engineers and program leadership to prioritize work, resolve cross-project dependencies, and scale consistent processes across the portfolio.
 Travel up to 25%, including international travel, to support site assessments, project milestones, commissioning, and handover.
 Who you are
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements
 5+ years of project management experience delivering complex physical security, workplace technology, low-voltage, construction, or similarly technical infrastructure projects.
 Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle, with ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder communication.
 Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery among technical teams, business partners, design and construction teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
 Strong vendor and contractor management skills, including defining requirements, managing contracts or statements of work, tracking delivery, and addressing performance issues.
 Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details into clear decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps for different audiences.
 Strong judgment and structured problem-solving skills; able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, anticipate issues, and drive timely decisions.
 Meticulous attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accurate documentation, standards, and operational handoffs.
 Experience establishing project management processes, tracking performance metrics, and applying lessons learned to improve future delivery.
 Working knowledge of physical security systems such as access control, video management, intrusion detection, intercoms, low-voltage infrastructure, and door hardware.
 Ability to travel internationally up to 25%.
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience delivering security infrastructure for offices in multiple countries or regions, particularly in EMEA.
 Experience with Genetec Security Center, including Synergis, Omnicast, Security Center SaaS, or Stratocast; active Genetec certification is a plus.
 Familiarity with system integrations, networking fundamentals, APIs, webhooks, or cloud-managed security technologies.
 Experience managing budgets, forecasts, vendor KPIs, SLAs, and portfolio-level reporting.
 Experience using project management and workflow tools such as Jira and Smartsheet.
 Experience reviewing and marking up construction and security design documentation using Bluebeam Revu or a similar PDF design-review tool, along with knowledge of commissioning practices and relevant local codes or regulatory requirements.

 Here at Clerky, we build software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. Recently acquired by Stripe, Clerky is now part of Stripe. We're profitable and growing sustainably. We're the most popular way for high-growth technology startups to form, and are also used by many top-tier startups for hiring and fundraising.
 As a Customer Support Specialist at Clerky, you will be the voice of the company to thousands of startup founders, investors, and attorneys. These customers use Clerky to get critical legal paperwork done, often on a tight timeline. Our success is based on word-of-mouth, so we have a strong culture of providing world-class service (ask us about our satisfaction ratings!). We are rabidly customer-centric.
 About the team
 It’s a lot harder here. Helping our customers can be unusually challenging due to the nuanced and specialized nature of their questions. Doing the job well can require a lot of iterative feedback, so we're looking for someone who thinks critically about their writing and is always looking for ways to improve. Along the way, you'll also pick up a lot of knowledge about startups and startup law. 
 The challenges never stop. The level of learning and craftsmanship that goes into writing responses to our customers requires intense focus. If you’re looking for the kind of position where you can easily master all the information at the beginning and work in a way that does not require intense focus, this position will probably not be a good fit for you. On the other hand, if you love learning and constantly challenging yourself, this position could be a good fit for you. 
 There are often no right answers. We’re often not able to provide definitive answers to the questions we receive. In many cases, the best we can do is to equip our customers with the information they need to be able to figure out the right answer on their own, or to understand that it isn’t possible to figure out what the right answer is. If you prefer an environment more oriented around providing definitive answers, this position may not be a good fit for you.

 Responsibilities
 Writing thoughtful and empathetic replies to customer emails using our help desk software, Help Scout
 Writing and maintaining help center articles, and identifying topics for new articles based on customer inquiries
 Working with our engineering team to debug software issues our customers encounter
 Using our software to develop and manage new ways for our customers to complete legal paperwork
 Assisting product team by testing new features and bug fixes, and conveying customer feedback
 Spotting trends in customer issues that other team members should be alerted to
 Who you are
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.  
 Minimum requirements
 Genuine love for helping people
 High emotional intelligence
 Logical / analytical thinker
 Exceptional written English communication skills, including the ability to write precisely and succinctly
 Extremely detail-oriented
 Comfort with working remotely and independently
 Technologically savvy - you should be confident in your ability to use new software without training
 Appreciation for giving and receiving feedback often (often several times a day)
 Natural internal motivation to constantly strive for excellence in everything you do

jobs.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Stripe Press publishes ideas for progress in technology, science, and economics because we believe that for many of the most significant breakthroughs in each of these categories, the key ingredient is ideas. The Stripe Press team is effectively a startup within Stripe; we have an unusual amount of autonomy and the trust of Stripe’s leadership team. 
 Our bar for publishing is high, and our list is small—by design. We’d rather publish fewer books than publish books we’re not passionate about and that we don’t think will challenge and galvanize our audience, which is global, fiercely curious, and shares our exacting standards.
 What you’ll do 
 Stripe Press is seeking a Managing Editor to own the editorial development and execution of its publishing program. You will guide intellectually ambitious nonfiction from acquisition through final proofs and production-ready handoff, upholding Press’s standards for rigor, clarity, accuracy, and editorial distinction.
 This role calls for exceptional editorial judgment and project management skills. You will work closely with Stripe Press’s editors, production manager, designers, authors, agents, and external specialists. You will also help build the systems and contributor network needed to support a growing list without compromising quality.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the editorial path of every Stripe Press book from acquisition through final proofs and handoff to production.
 Establish and manage editorial schedules spanning manuscript delivery, editorial review, revision, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, indexing, proofreading, and final approval.
 Evaluate manuscripts for structure, argument, clarity, pacing, voice, evidence, and accessibility, ensuring that complex ideas remain accurate and intellectually substantive.
 Establish clear expectations with authors and provide candid, actionable guidance throughout development. Provide direct developmental or line-editing support when a project requires senior intervention.
 Determine the appropriate editorial and verification process for each book, including when to commission technical, legal, or other specialist review.
 Build, commission, and supervise a trusted network of developmental editors, line editors, copyeditors, fact-checkers, proofreaders, indexers, typesetters, and specialist reviewers.
 Give final editorial approval before manuscripts enter production, and remain responsible for editorial decisions and author review through the proof stages.
 Maintain the Stripe Press house style and create clear, repeatable workflows and handoffs across editorial and production.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 You have significant experience managing complex nonfiction books at a trade, academic, journalistic, or ideas-focused publishing organization.
 You demonstrate exceptional editorial judgment across structure, argument, prose, evidence, and authorial voice.
 You are comfortable working with technical, scientific, economic, historical, or otherwise research-intensive nonfiction.
 You have deep knowledge of developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, fact-checking, permissions, proofreading, and editorial-production workflows.
 You are an exceptional project manager, capable of coordinating multiple complex projects and timelines with a high degree of precision.
 You enjoy operating in a small, ambitious organization where systems are still being built, and you share Stripe Press’s appetite for ideas that can improve how people understand and shape the world.
 Preferred qualifications 
 You have helped launch or materially scale a publishing program, list, or imprint.
 You have developed editorial standards, tools, or workflows that improved quality and execution in a growing organization.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 
 Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
 Your role 
 Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.
 To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.
 Who you are 
 Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
 Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
 Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.
 Minimum requirements 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
 Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
 Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
 Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
 Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
 Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.
 Preferred qualifications 
 One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
 Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
 Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
 Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
 Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Risk
jobs.description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.
 Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.
 At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.
 What you’ll do
 As a Staff Product Manager on the Risk team, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.
 You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.
 Responsibilities
 Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.
 Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
 Lead changes in Risk’s approach to using data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.
 Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and machine learning leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.
 Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.
 Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolve difficult tradeoffs, and drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.
 You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and product managers around you without needing to manage them.
 Minimum requirements
 A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.
 Demonstrated ability to bring clarity to deeply ambiguous problems, set a compelling direction, and drive work through execution and adoption.
 Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.
 Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.
 Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.
 Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.
 Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.
 High agency, intellectual honesty, curiosity, and a low-ego, hands-on working style.
 Preferred qualifications 
 An engineering background, preferably with a focus on machine learning.
 Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.
 Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.
 Experience working with globally distributed teams.

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
 The Role 
 As an Enterprise Sales Lead, US , you will lead and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives responsible for winning Square's most strategic sellers and partner with enterprise sales leadership to shape our next stage of growth.
 This is a leadership role for a proven enterprise sales leader who can set strategy, raise execution standards, coach complex deals, and build a high-performing team. You will be accountable for enterprise pipeline, deal quality, forecast discipline, and revenue outcomes across a focused set of high-value prospects and sellers. You’ll lead and develop Enterprise Account Executives while staying close to the most strategic opportunities.
 You’ll partner deeply with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and sales leadership to bring the full Square ecosystem to market.
 This is a hands-on people leadership role for someone who has built and scaled high-performing enterprise sales teams in a market where commerce, payments, software, data, and AI are converging. You'll bring the judgment of an experienced sales leader, the technical curiosity to sell a platform, and the operating discipline to turn an emerging motion into a repeatable business.
 You Will 
 Build and coach a high-performing enterprise team: Hire, develop, and lead Enterprise Account Executives through clear expectations, deal coaching, pipeline inspection, direct feedback, and accountability for results. Raise talent density and set the performance standard for enterprise selling at Square.

 Deliver new enterprise acquisition outcomes: Be accountable for pipeline creation, new enterprise seller wins, revenue, and forecast accuracy, and partner with implementation and account teams to turn signed agreements into successful launches and sustained processing volume.
 Establish a rigorous operating cadence: Create consistent rhythms for pipeline reviews, forecast calls, account planning, deal inspection, and performance management, and hold the team to a high standard of accuracy and preparation in each.
 Own account prioritization and coverage: Partner with enterprise sales leadership to translate enterprise priorities into account and territory plans, then direct team capacity toward the prospects with the strongest strategic fit and commercial potential.
 Raise the bar on deal execution and deal quality: Coach the team through complex deal constructs and multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning executive, technical, commercial, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders. Hold a high standard on deal economics, implementation feasibility, and commitments Square can deliver.
 Codify repeatable sales motions for upmarket growth: Create scalable approaches to account planning, qualification, discovery, business case development, executive engagement, negotiation, and closing, so wins become repeatable patterns rather than one-offs.
 Lead the most strategic deals from the front: Set account strategy, open executive doors, drive complex negotiations, and clear blockers on the highest-priority pursuits. Build and own trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers, and make the case for Square yourself when the deal demands it.
 Partner cross-functionally to win: Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, implementation, and sales leadership to align internal teams around strategic opportunities, and move deals forward.
 Turn market insight into business impact: Bring customer, competitor, partner, and market feedback back into Square to influence product, pricing, packaging, partnerships, and go-to-market strategy.
 You Have 
 10+ years of enterprise or strategic sales experience, including a strong track record of exceeding targets and closing complex, high-value deals
 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated record of leading enterprise teams to hit revenue targets and of hiring, ramping, and developing Account Executives who perform
 Experience leading enterprise teams in complex platform, SaaS, fintech, payments, data, or commerce environments
 Experience building pipeline-generation motions, including outbound prospecting, account-based programs, and partner-sourced opportunities
 Proven ability to build territory, segmentation, and coverage strategies in a developing or high-growth market
 Deep experience leading teams through complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving executive, technical, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders
 Commercial acumen to coach teams on pricing, negotiation, business case development, deal structure, and deal economics
 Operating and analytical discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and deal inspection, with comfort using data to improve conversion and make resource decisions
 Executive presence and credibility—you communicate with precision, challenge constructively, and earn trust with senior decision-makers
 Technical curiosity and the ability to sell business value across APIs, integrations, data, automation, and emerging AI use cases

 Own the global information governance roadmap, establishing review schedules, maintenance priorities, and scalable processes that ensure sales content and knowledge remain accurate, relevant, and up to date.Design and implement automated governance workflows that streamline content reviews, approval routing, version control, expiration tracking, and archiving, reducing manual effort and improving consistency.
 Build AI-powered processes to identify outdated, duplicated, or inconsistent information across sales knowledge platforms, helping proactively surface content that requires review or updates.Develop automated review and notification systems that alert content owners and subject-matter experts when information requires validation, approval, or replacement.
 Oversee governance of sales email content, including approved outreach templates, nurture sequences, competitive emails, and account management communications, ensuring messaging, claims, and product information remain accurate and current.
 Coordinate cross-functional information reviews, partnering with subject-matter experts across Product Marketing, Product, Competitive Intelligence, Partnerships, Legal, and other teams to validate and maintain critical sales information.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Revenue team
 The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.
 About the Role 
 Affirm is seeking a dynamic and passionate Partner Marketing Lead to support and coordinate co-marketing initiatives with our valued merchants across North America. You will help plan and execute strategic cross-channel marketing campaigns across onsite Marketplace placements, offsite media, affiliate, and other emerging channels. These campaigns will be designed to drive revenue growth, GMV, customer acquisition, and measurable value for Affirm and our merchant partners.
 You’ll work closely with external partners and internal cross-functional teams, including Client Success, Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Brand and Creative, and Legal and Compliance, to coordinate and deliver impactful campaigns aimed at driving GMV (gross merchandise volume), brand awareness, new user acquisition, and lifetime value. You should feel comfortable working across several industries, including home, fitness, electronics, fashion, and omnichannel retail. You’re a collaborative marketer who is eager to navigate complex challenges, deliver strong execution, and build trusted relationships with marketing counterparts.
 What You’ll Do 
 Support the development and coordinate the execution of full-funnel co-marketing campaigns across categories and channels, including onsite, offsite, and affiliate. This includes supporting go-to-market plans, monthly planning, and cross-functional campaign delivery.
 Build and nurture day-to-day marketing relationships with a set of merchant partners, identifying opportunities to improve performance and support growth.
 Support the marketing strategy and campaign performance of assigned merchant partners, identifying opportunities to grow merchant investment and contribute to revenue, GMV, and performance goals.
 Execute and optimize Affirm Marketing Solutions programs across onsite Marketplace placements, offsite media, affiliate, and emerging channels.
 Analyze campaign performance and translate results into actionable insights and recommendations that improve future investment, iROAS, and program performance.
 Serve as a merchant advocate and coordinate with internal cross-functional teams to improve execution, streamline processes, and share campaign learnings.
 Coordinate inbound RFP requests, supporting the development of dedicated marketing plans and materials for prospective partners.
 Help identify campaign targets based on business goals focused on acquisition, engagement, and loan takeup.
 Work closely with the media agency, Growth Marketing, and Brand and Creative teams to coordinate media plans, creative briefs, and content development.
 Support business-critical processes, including partner marketing budget tracking, the comprehensive co-marketing calendar, compliance submissions, and campaign documentation.
 Leverage industry knowledge and research to contribute to vertical-specific marketing strategies and plans that support business goals.
 What We Look For 
 6+ years of experience in Partner, Performance, Affiliate, or Product Marketing.
 Experience working with partners to develop plans and launch marketing programs across multiple media channels.
 Experience with CPA, CPC, CPL, and CPM payment models.
 A clear understanding of affiliate tracking models, tools, and platforms.
 Analytical and data-oriented, with a focus on using performance metrics to build campaigns that deliver results.
 Experience using performance analytics to identify insights and continuously optimize campaigns.
 A commercial mindset, with experience identifying opportunities to grow partner investment and contribute to revenue and performance goals.
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
 The ability to influence others and coordinate resources and relationships to deliver strong results.
 A motivated self-starter who looks for opportunities to share knowledge and improve how the team works.
 An understanding of the paid media landscape, including cross-media strategy, planning, and measurement.
 Experience writing creative briefs, testing creative, and adapting campaigns based on insights.
 Experience working with online retail, merchandising, and customer acquisition.
 Experience with both online and in-store retail marketing.
 Experience marketing across North America, particularly the US and Canada, preferred.
 Experience in the home, fitness, consumer electronics, or fashion industries is a plus.
 Pay Grade - I 
Equity Grade - 5 
 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.
 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.
 What You'll Do 
· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.
 What We Look For 
· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Sr. CRM Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 
 We're hiring a Sr. CRM Operations Manager to help transform how Chime's Lifecycle Marketing & CRM team operates and scales. You'll lead our most important cross-functional CRM initiatives, connecting Lifecycle Marketing, MarTech, Engineering, and other partners to turn complex business needs into scalable systems and processes. As a strategic individual contributor, you'll influence technical roadmaps, improve operational efficiency, and help us build smarter, more automated member experiences. This isn't a daily campaign execution or engineering role—your impact will come from bringing teams together, solving complex operational challenges, and building systems that help us move faster.
 In this role, you can expect to 
 Lead high-impact CRM initiatives: Own complex, cross-functional programs such as platform migrations, channel integrations, and automation transformations—from early discovery through implementation and adoption.
 Connect Marketing with Product and Engineering: Translate lifecycle marketing goals into clear business requirements, data specifications, and technical priorities, helping teams align on what needs to be built and why.
 Make CRM operations more scalable: Improve campaign intake, QA standards, documentation, governance, and prioritization processes so teams can execute more efficiently and with fewer errors.
 Strengthen channel health and compliance: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Data, and channel owners to improve deliverability, consent management, frequency capping, and messaging quality.
 Drive the evolution of lifecycle automation: Help move our CRM ecosystem beyond manual, campaign-focused workflows toward automated, scalable, and intelligent member journeys.
 Influence teams and priorities: Work closely with senior stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, and drive decisions without relying on direct reporting authority.
 Deliver measurable operational impact: Establish success metrics and connect improvements in workflows, systems, and governance to efficiency, execution quality, risk reduction, and downstream business outcomes.
 To thrive in this role, you have 
 8+ years of experience in CRM operations, marketing program management, or marketing technology alignment, with a track record of working in complex marketing environments.
 Demonstrated ownership of large cross-functional initiatives , taking ambiguous business problems through planning, implementation, stakeholder alignment, and successful adoption.
 Strong business-to-technical translation skills , including experience turning marketing needs into actionable requirements for Product, Engineering, and data teams.
 Deep familiarity with enterprise CRM platforms such as Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including how data infrastructure supports lifecycle marketing capabilities.
 Experience building scalable operating frameworks , including campaign intake, operational governance, quality assurance, and documentation standards.
 Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills , with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve competing priorities, and drive decisions without direct authority.
 A process-first, outcomes-oriented mindset , with the ability to identify operational friction, implement sustainable improvements, and measure their impact.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

We are hiring for a leader for the newly forming Detection and Response team at Plaid. Our mission is to protect Plaid's financial infrastructure by detecting and responding to suspicious activity across the company. We are responsible for the entire lifecycle of detection and response, including detection infrastructure, AI triage and response, investigation tooling, Red Teaming, and Fraud Operations. Security is foundational to the trust thousands of businesses and millions of consumers place in Plaid, and we work directly to reduce risks and enable our business to move faster and safer.

As the Head of Detection and Response, you will be the founding leader responsible for standing up and evaluating Plaid's detection and response team. You will lead a specialized technical team of analysts and engineers, gain deep experience partnering with the CISO and cross-functional engineering leaders, and build critical security infrastructure at scale. This is a unique leadership opportunity to manage a team that encompasses traditional security operations alongside Red Teaming and Fraud Operations, directly impacting Plaid's security posture and long-term stability.

Responsibilities:

 - Form and set up Plaid’s Detection and Response team from scratch, defining its culture and operational standards.

 - Lead the day-to-day operations for incident response and evaluate the overall effectiveness of the detection and response program.

 - Manage and mentor a technical team responsible for detection infrastructure, AI-driven triage, and investigation tooling.

 - Oversee Fraud Operations and Red Team activities to ensure a proactive and comprehensive security posture.

 - Partner with senior leadership (CISO, CTO, COO) to communicate security risks and maturity gains achieved through influence and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Define and track metrics to evaluate and demonstrate the effectiveness of the D&R program

Qualifications:

 - Must haves:
   
   - 8-14 years of overall detection and response or security engineering experience.
   
   - Strong technical background in security or detection engineering, with the ability to guide work on SIEMs, EDR, and SOC operations.
   
   - Experience managing a team of security analysts and engineers in an operational, platform, or infrastructure context.
   
   - Ability to build cross-functional relationships and drive security maturity through influence rather than authority.
   
   - High-empathy communication skills with the ability to represent technical work to Staff-level leadership.
   
   - Strong AI-first skillset applicable to security operations.

   - Experience at a fintech or high-technology organization adjacent to payments/finance.

jobs.title: AML Compliance Officer Customer Risk
jobs.description:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen is the financial technology platform of choice for leading companies. By providing end-to-end payments capabilities, data-driven insights, and financial products in a single global solution, Adyen helps businesses achieve their ambitions faster. With offices around the world, Adyen works with the likes of Facebook, Uber, H&M, eBay, and Microsoft. To maintain our momentum, we need people to join us in finding new ways of solving our unique challenges.
 AML Compliance Officer Customer Risk  
 A key part of building our business is ensuring we do it ethically, securely, and sustainably. In order to do so, Adyen needs to understand and monitor at all times what happens on our platform and whether this is in line with regulations and our risk appetite. And that in a scalable, automated, and adaptive way.
 To achieve this, we are looking for a Compliance Officer to join our AML/CFT Compliance Department based in Amsterdam, covering our global business. In this role, you will be the Second Line expert responsible for driving the evolution of Adyen’s Customer Risk and broader CDD Framework .
 Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, you will bridge regulatory requirements with technical product execution. You will work directly alongside Product Management, Engineering, and Regulatory teams to design, embed and monitor effectiveness of scalable, data-driven customer risk scoring models that minimize customer friction while ensuring rock-solid regulatory compliance.
 Are you a senior specialist who excels at translating complex CDD/KYC regulatory requirements into scalable operating frameworks? Then this is the role for you!
 What you'll do
 CDD Framework: Drive continuous maturity of Adyen's global CDD framework, translating regulatory expectations and supervisory guidelines (e.g., DNB, EU AML Regulation) into processes and procedures.
 Customer Onboarding: Align and evolve Adyen's global CDD procedures, defining baseline Financial Crime data requirements as well as standards for customer onboarding and ongoing review. Support relevant teams in translating it into clear 1st LoD operational guidelines.
 Customer Risk Scoring: Support the design and implementation of Adyen's risk-based approach toward customer risks, conducting deep-dive assessments of potential integrity risks across complex business models and platform structures.
 Product Collaboration: Partner up with our Product and Engineering teams to translate compliance procedures and risk-scoring logic into scalable, automated customer risk solutions.
 Operational Alignment: Support operational execution by designing, refining, and reviewing operational guidelines and 2nd-line oversight mechanisms for customer risk reviews.
 Audit & Regulatory Reviews: Support internal audits and regulatory examinations by explaining customer risk scoring logic and CDD framework design.
 Who you are 
 You're a CDD & Customer Risk Expert: You bring 4+ years of hands-on experience in financial crime, CDD/KYC framework design, or customer risk classification within a fast-scaling fintech, tier-1 bank, or specialized compliance practice.
 KYC Data & Product Fluency: You understand the mechanics of KYC data requirements. You can discuss data structures, API workflows, and onboarding logic with Product Managers just as comfortably as you discuss regulatory frameworks with senior stakeholders.
 Framework Architecture: Experience in building, refining, or operationalizing CDD frameworks, risk-based approaches, or customer risk methodologies in complex organizational setups is a plus.
 Strong Project & Stakeholder Management: Excellent organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage stakeholders, and bridge the gap between Product & Tech, Regulatory, and Operations.
 Pragmatic & Solution-Oriented: You view compliance as an enabler of sustainable growth, balancing strict regulatory expectations with seamless user experience.
 Clear Communication: Fluent in spoken and written English.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
 Please note that this role is a full-time position in Amsterdam . Relocation will be required if you currently reside outside of the Netherlands.

You will architect data and work on complex challenges across the company, multiplying your impact through the teams and people you work with.  What you will do 
 Build greenfield. The mandate, the architecture and the standards are being written now. You help write them.
 Design the foundation. Set the target architecture for shared data models, data contracts and the semantic layer that every domain builds on.
 Give every metric one clear meaning. Work with domain teams so each core metric is defined once and owned by the domain that creates it. Variants get their own names.
 Make data contracts the norm. Agree contracts between producers and consumers, with owners, versions and automatic checks. Consumers are never surprised.
 Build lineage in from the start. Anyone can trace a figure to its source without asking the engineer who built the pipeline.
 Help teams ship data products. Guide domain teams to publish datasets with a clear owner, schema and service level. They own the product. You own the standard.
 Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, review designs and solve hard problems in the data stack.

 Grow other engineers. Mentor engineers in Data Foundations and in the domains. Help them solve problems with their own ideas, and raise the bar in design reviews.

 You have 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, and you have worked at Staff scope. You have set direction for more than one team, and you are still hands on.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

 - Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

 - Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

 - Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

 - Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

 - Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

 - Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

 - Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

 - Big Four background.

 - Experience building and testing risk controls.

 - A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

 - Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

 - Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

 - Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

 - Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

 - Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

 - Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred

 - Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

 - Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

 - People management experience.

 - Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

 - Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

 - Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.

 - You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.
