What you'll do

As the Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence, you’ll lead proactive, complex, and high-risk anti-money laundering and financial crime investigations across Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure. You’ll act as an investigative subject-matter expert and operational lead, helping identify and mitigate risks across cross-border payments, corporate accounts, cards, FX and embedded finance. 



Responsibilities:

 - Lead end-to-end investigations into complex financial crime typologies involving cross-border payment flows, multi-currency corporate accounts, complex ownership structures, cross-product financial-crime risks, KYB/UBO considerations and high-risk corridors.

 - Oversee case intake, triage, prioritisation and assignment for special investigations, ensuring matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise are resolved thoroughly and within established SLAs.

 - Lead financial-crime-related internal fraud and insider-threat investigations where employees or insiders may be involved in fraud, collusion with external parties, misuse of access or other conduct with a financial-crime nexus. Partner with Fraud, Infosec, People/HR, Employment Legal and senior management. Provide evidence-based findings and risk-based recommendations.

 - Analyse layered international transactions across payment rails including SWIFT, local clearing rails, card schemes and alternative payment methods to trace illicit fund movements, identify beneficial owners and uncover hidden counterparty networks.

 - Provide investigative analysis, suspect and typology recommendations, quality assurance and escalation support for SAR/STR cases, enabling MLROs to make final filing decisions in accordance with local requirements.

 - Translate investigative findings into actionable feedback for Risk, Data and Engineering teams to calibrate transaction monitoring rules, improve automated detection models and address control vulnerabilities.

 - Develop and maintain financial-crime typologies, investigative intelligence and threat assessment based on internal investigations, external intelligence, and regulatory guidance; translate these insights into control improvements, targeted training and intelligence briefings.

 - Partner with Transaction Monitoring, Onboarding and EDD, Sanctions, Fraud, Legal and regional MLROs to address systemic threats and implement coordinated risk-mitigation measures.

 - Build and maintain investigative playbooks, investigative analysis, typology context and case documentation standards and quality-assurance frameworks tailored to B2B fintech, complex law-enforcement referrals, regulatory information request, partner-bank inquiries and partner due-diligence reviews..

 - Support internal audits, independent reviews and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation, case files and briefings on investigative methodologies and outcomes.

 - Provide day-to-day guidance, peer reviews and typology training to investigators and analysts across the broader Financial Crime Compliance team.



Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum qualifications:

 - 8+ years of dedicated experience in AML/CFT investigations, financial intelligence or special investigations within cross-border payments, global fintech, merchant acquiring or international corporate and commercial banking.

 - Deep understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, including SWIFT, local ACH and clearing schemes, and FX; business payment flows; merchant acquiring; and corporate entity structures, including complex shareholding, shell companies and beneficial ownership.

 - A proven track record of independently conducting and documenting complex, multi-layered financial crime investigations from initiation through documented findings, risk recommendations and support to the MLRO-led regulatory reporting process.

 - Solid working knowledge of global AML/CTF and sanctions regulatory frameworks, including, where applicable,FATF recommendations, FinCEN/BSA, FCA, AUSTRAC,MAS and other relevant local regulatory requirements.

 - A strong analytical mindset, with experience querying, synthesising and interpreting large datasets of transactional and customer data.

 - Exceptional written communication skills, demonstrated through investigative narratives and SAR/STR drafting, with the ability to articulate complex financial crime risks to non-compliance stakeholders, including Product and Engineering.

 - Comfort working in a high-growth and rapidly evolving fintech environment, managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.



Preferred qualifications:

 - A professional certification such as CAMS, CFE or an equivalent ICA diploma.

 - Practical experience with data querying and visualisation tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau or network/link analysis software.

 - Experience investigating financial crime risks in digital assets or crypto rails, or embedded finance/BaaS integrations.

jobs.description:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Engineering at Brex 
 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.
 What you’ll do 
 The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.
 As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
 Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
 Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
 Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
 Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
 Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
 Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.
 Requirements 
 You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
 You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
 You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
 You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
 You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
 You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
 You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.
 Bonus points 
 You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
 You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
 You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
 You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.
 Compensation:

However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Lead is a banking infrastructure platform trusted by the most innovative companies to power complex financial products. We enable fintechs to offer compliant, programmable services like payments, lending, and digital assets at scale. Banking has moved beyond traditional institutions and is now embedded directly into everyday experiences, meaning companies need modern infrastructure that is safe, secure, and operationally sound.

Today, Lead is one of the only API-first, developer-focused partner banks with the financial, regulatory, and legal expertise required to help fintechs succeed. We operate offices in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, and New York City, and an FDIC-insured bank in Kansas City.



Information Security Team at Lead

The Information Security team helps Lead stay nimble enough to move fast without compromising on safety. They own cybersecurity, overseeing detection and response, and building security controls for all data networks, cloud infrastructures, and IT systems. Working closely with the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams, they ensure Lead meets and stays up to date on all security standards. Scaling the systems that protect Lead and the fintechs we serve requires critical thinking, good judgment, and an ownership mentality. This is a collaborative team of builders who approach problems creatively, constantly iterating to improve the security of our platform.



Role Description

Lead Bank is looking for a Senior Security Analyst to join our Security Operations team. You'll be a core contributor to our detection and response capabilities — building detections, triaging alerts, responding to incidents, and proactively hunting threats across cloud infrastructure, security tooling, and data pipelines. You'll mentor junior analysts and partner with leadership to drive our security posture forward. Your expertise will be vital in navigating the complex regulatory landscape of the banking industry and defending against advanced persistent threats.

 - Collaborate with Engineering on IaC and CI/CD security reviews, and contribute to runbooks and playbooks

 - Perform all other duties as assigned

Required

 - 5+ years in information security or security operations

 - Hands-on SIEM experience with query writing, detection building, and alert tuning

 - Strong working knowledge of cloud security concepts and services (AWS preferred; GCP and Azure also considered)

 - Proficiency working with logs across endpoint, cloud, network, identity, and application sources

 - Demonstrated IR experience, including leading or contributing to investigations

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

 - Experience with log routing, transformation, and enrichment

 - Hands-on experience with an enterprise EDR/XDR platform and its ecosystem tooling — SOAR, exposure management, and identity protection

 - Experience with network security tools and interpreting proxy or web traffic logs Background in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with familiarity with NIST CSF, GLBA, or FFIEC

 - Relevant certifications: CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, CEH, GDSA, or equivalent

Nice to Have

 - Detection as Code experience using version-controlled detection content

 - Exposure to identity security tooling

Art Blakey led the Jazz Messengers from behind the drums. He brought musicians including Wayne Shorter and Lee Morgan into the band, encouraged them to write new music, and helped them develop into bandleaders themselves. His contribution was both the music he made and the talent he brought forward. Blue Note Records 
 We’re looking for a Design Manager with that combination of creative leadership and personal craft. Someone with strong design judgement, deep visual craft, and the ambition to change what businesses expect from financial software.
 You’ll lead design for Mercury’s Business Banking* and Investments teams, spanning payments, accounts, and treasury. These teams help businesses move money, organize their accounts, and put idle cash to work. As the team grows, you’ll be accountable for the quality of its work, the development of its designers, and the impact of the experiences it ships.
 Our ambition goes beyond making familiar banking workflows look better. We want to question how they work, identify what customers should no longer have to think about, and create something meaningfully better. That takes a leader who can recognize a promising idea, push it further, and bring a team together to make it real.
 Visual design matters deeply in this role. So do interaction design, simplicity, and the judgment to make them work together. You should have a clear point of view about what excellent looks like and the hands-on ability to demonstrate it. You’ll hold a high standard through specific feedback, compelling direction, and a willingness to work alongside the team. People should feel inspired to do the best work of their careers, and supported in getting there.
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 Raise the quality bar of the team's work. Own the visual and interaction quality of the experiences your team ships, from the structure of a complex workflow to typography, composition, spacing, and motion. Make the standard concrete through thoughtful critique and clear direction. Review the implemented experience, not just the design file.
 Challenge the status quo. Partner with Product and Engineering to shape an ambitious direction for payments, accounts, and treasury. Question inherited assumptions, including our own. Help the team distinguish genuine constraints from familiar habits, explore alternatives, and turn the strongest ideas into simpler, more useful products.
 Take ownership from problem to outcome. Identify opportunities without waiting for a brief. Create clarity when the path is ambiguous, bring the right people together, make decisions, and work through obstacles. Your responsibility continues after handoff and launch: understand what changed for customers and the business, and act when the results fall short.
 Get hands-on where your craft makes a difference. Sketch a stronger direction, prototype an interaction, or work through a difficult flow with a designer. Be able to show what better looks like, not only describe it. Use your skills selectively to advance the work and develop the designer’s judgment without taking over their ownership.
 Turn ambition into excellent work that ships on time. Make deliberate decisions about scope, sequencing, and where to spend the team’s attention. Surface tradeoffs early and resolve them with your partners. Know which details are essential to the experience and where a simpler approach will help the team move faster without compromising what matters.
 Build a healthy team with high expectations. Develop designers’ taste, confidence, and ability to deliver. Give direct, useful feedback, set clear performance expectations, and address gaps with care and conviction. Explain why the work matters and bring people together around a shared vision. Celebrate the designers behind the work and make their contributions visible across Mercury Design.
 You should: 
 Have strong visual and interaction design craft. Your portfolio demonstrates thoughtful typography,  composition, hierarchy, and interaction design in shipped products.
 Know how to simplify complex product experiences. You can work through complicated workflows, information architecture, and product constraints to make experiences clear and intuitive.
 Have managed designers and raised the quality of their work . You can show how your coaching, feedback, and clear expectations helped designers grow and improved what reached customers. You know how to inspire ambition while holding people accountable.
 Have set a product vision and helped a team deliver it. You can connect an ambitious direction to practical decisions about scope and sequencing, with shipped work and clear customer or business impact.
 Stay close to the design work. You’re comfortable sketching, prototyping, and working through detailed design problems alongside designers, with the judgment to know when your direct contribution will help.
 Build strong partnerships with Product and Engineering. You’ve shaped priorities together, worked through competing constraints, and used clear storytelling to build alignment around design decisions.
 Think and work like an owner. You act on what’s best for customers and the business, not just what’s in the brief. You spot problems and opportunities before they’re assigned, make decisions with incomplete information, and adapt without drama when priorities shift. You stay close to implementation and outcomes, and you care more about making Mercury better than about whose idea it was.
 Build conviction without relying on authority. You can tell a clear story about where the product should go and why. You start disagreements with curiosity, make your reasoning specific, and change your mind when a better idea emerges. You help people pursue a demanding standard because they understand and believe in it.
 What success looks like 
 A year from now, the team’s shipped work demonstrates a visibly higher standard of visual craft, interaction quality, and simplicity. It has moved beyond incremental improvements to deliver new approaches with clear customer and business impact. Designers are ambitious, motivated, and growing in their judgment. They own their work, deliver reliably, and receive recognition across Mercury Design for what they contribute.
 Please share examples of both your own design craft and work produced under your leadership. We’d like to understand the standards you set, the assumptions you challenged, the decisions you owned, and what ultimately shipped.

jobs.description:
Holds. Limits. Locks. Closures. The judicious use of these tools is designed to protect good customers. But if wielded maladroitly, good customers get entangled in unnecessary friction, burden our operations teams, and may become detractors and churn. At Mercury, we believe banking* should be empowering and seamless, not difficult, confusing, or stressful.
 As a Product Manager for Fraud, you’ll build products that enable Mercury to master these tools and deftly balance customer experience with fraud prevention. You'll develop a deep understanding of our customers, their accounts, and our money movement products to build systems that protect our customers and Mercury from fraud. You’ll work cross-functionally to build products for both end users and internal risk teams that enable Mercury to provide a seamless and safe banking* experience.

 Shape the strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention across your area, from account integrity or money movement to the decisions, controls, and experiences that protect customers

 Craft user journeys that apply appropriate friction based on risk signals while minimizing disruption to good users
 Build operational and platform tooling to enable our risk and support teams to efficiently manage case volume, exceptions and high-touch cases
 Partner with data science to develop, deploy, and continuously improve ML models 
 Establish and track metrics that measure both risk effectiveness, operational, and customer experience impact
 Support the development of Mercury's risk capabilities to scale across our expanding product suite
 What You Bring:
 7+ years of relevant product management experience, including experience within fraud or risk in banking or fintech environments

jobs.title: Dealer Development Manager (Las Vegas, NV)
jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. 
 We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.  
 We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 
 About the Role: 
 The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement.   This position requires residency in the greater Las Vegas area. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Dealer Relationship Management 
 Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners 
 Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers 
 Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule 
 Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty 
 Dealer Acquisition & Activation 
 Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners 
 Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”) 
 Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production 
 Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems 
 Production & Volume Growth 
 Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals 
 Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production 
 Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality 
 Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month) 
 Credit & Deal Structuring 
 Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively 
 Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging 
 Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals 
 Portfolio Performance & Quality 
 Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability) 
 Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals 
 Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers 
 Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards 
 Training & Dealer Development 
 Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff 
 Educate dealers on value-added products  
 Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success 
 Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender 
 Territory & Activity Management 
 Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time 
 Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce) 
 Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data 
 Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews 
 What We Look For: 
 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field 
 Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations 
 Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills 
 Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills 
 Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

 Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan 
 Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 
 Flexible PTO 
 Competitive 401(k) 
 Opportunities for professional growth and development 
 Paid parental leave 
 Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Merchant Risk Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. 
 We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.  
 We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 
 About the Role: 
 Upgrade is looking for a Merchant Risk Data Analyst to transform how we identify and mitigate merchant risk through data analysis and visualization. You'll combine merchant risk expertise with analytical skills to build predictive models, automated monitoring triggers, and actionable insights that protect our platform from fraud, compliance violations, and operational failures. You'll turn millions of transactional data points into strategic risk decisions, applying analytical rigor to catch problems early and safeguard our merchants, borrowers, and business. 
What You'll Do: 
 Analyze large volumes of transactional data to identify merchant risk patterns and trends 
 Build predictive models to forecast merchant fraud, financial distress, compliance issues, and operational red flags 
 Develop risk scoring methodologies that prioritize high-risk merchants for proactive review 
 Conduct historical trend analysis to understand how merchant risk evolves over time and across verticals 
 Identify leading indicators of merchant misconduct, project abandonment, chargebacks, and borrower harm 
 Design automated merchant risk triggers based on transactional behavior and performance metrics 
 Create early-warning systems for financial distress, fraud patterns, compliance violations, and operational deterioration 
 Optimize trigger logic to balance detection accuracy with operational efficiency 
 Collaborate with Engineering and Product to operationalize triggers into monitoring workflows 
 Monitor trigger performance and adjust thresholds based on investigation outcomes 
 Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for merchant investigations using transactional data, WIP trends, chargeback patterns, and complaint analysis 
 Create visualizations that empower the Merchant Risk team to investigate merchants quickly and effectively 
 Develop performance metrics reporting for team productivity, investigation outcomes, and risk mitigation effectiveness 
 Design executive-level reporting on merchant risk trends and portfolio health 
 Ensure dashboards are intuitive, accurate, and actionable 
 Partner with Merchant Risk Managers and analysts to understand investigation needs and data gaps 
 Provide data-driven recommendations to improve risk detection and investigation efficiency 
 Collaborate with Sales, Credit, Compliance, FinCrimes, and Product teams on risk strategy 
 Present findings and recommendations to leadership in clear, compelling formats 
 Stay current on merchant risk trends, fraud schemes, and industry best practices 
 What We Look For: 
 3+ years merchant risk experience in fraud detection, compliance monitoring, underwriting, or risk operations (fintech, payments, or lending preferred) 
 Strong SQL skills for querying large datasets and performing complex data analysis 
 Proficiency in Tableau (or similar BI tools) for building dashboards and visualizations 
 Experience with predictive modeling and statistical analysis (regression, classification, clustering) 
 Excel/Google Sheets expertise for data manipulation, pivot tables, and analysis 
 Deep merchant risk knowledge: fraud patterns, financial distress indicators, compliance red flags, operational issues, borrower harm signals 
 Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and ability to spot patterns in complex data 
 Clear communication to translate analytical findings for non-technical audiences 
Nice to Have: 
 Experience with Python or R for data analysis and modeling 
 Familiarity with machine learning techniques and model validation 
 Knowledge of merchant underwriting, credit risk, or transaction monitoring 
 Experience with WIP (Work-in-Progress) data in project-based lending 
 Background in home improvement, solar, elective medical, or other merchant verticals 
 Understanding of regulatory requirements (UDAAP, state licensing, consumer protection) 
 Prior experience building automated alerting systems or risk triggers 
 What We Offer You:  
 Competitive salary and stock option plan 
 100% paid coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance  
 Flexible PTO 
 Competitive 401(k)  
 Opportunities for professional growth and development    
 Paid parental leave 
 Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Director of Fund Services
jobs.description:
About AngelList
Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them. What's missing is the financial system public markets spent a century building: exchanges, custodians, brokers, and ways for ordinary people to buy in. Private markets, now $28T, never had the equivalent. AngelList is building it.
The last decade of structural innovation in venture happened here: syndicates, SPVs at scale, Rolling Funds, scout programs. Today we have $200B+ in assets and 30,000+ startups funded on our platform. The rest of private markets is next. Funds is the software and services behind private funds, Nova is the banking network, Meridian is the wealth platform for accredited investors, and USVC is the brand behind a registered fund that lets anyone invest in venture.
Working here means an unusual amount of agency on a problem that matters. Titles are closer to suggestions, and there are about 200 of us building what private markets never had. Come build it with us.
 
 Lead operational changes to make AI tooling work in practice: team responsibilities, controls, training, and measures of success.
 Develop managers, set clear accountability, and build the service capabilities needed for larger clients.
 Improve delivery times and productivity.
 Resolve root causes of errors and prevent repeat incidents.
 Use operational evidence to prioritize workflow changes and safe, useful automation with Product and Engineering.
 Keep the client’s experience at the center of operational decisions. Have built and scaled complex operations with financial, legal, tax, or compliance consequences.
 Are excited by the opportunity to reshape a complex service business with AI.
 Can explain the scale you managed and the results you delivered.
 Have led managers through meaningful change.
 Combine sound risk judgment with strong client instincts and practical technology experience.
 Have built or run strong control environments: preventive and detective controls, clear ownership, and evidence that holds up to audit.
 Can learn a complex domain quickly while working through experienced managers.
 Fund administration experience is valuable, but we are open to adjacent backgrounds with a clear record of learning quickly. A CPA is not required.

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. This role is responsible for leading the successful delivery of client implementations and ongoing client delivery portfolios. This individual serves as a senior client-facing leader accountable for delivery outcomes, client satisfaction, and operational discipline.
 This role will lead delivery teams across multiple concurrent engagements, partnering closely with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure priorities are clear, risks are addressed early, and commitments are met. This leader will bring strong executive presence, sound judgment, and a structured approach to solving complex delivery challenges while continuously improving the processes, practices, and operating models that support scalable client delivery. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented leader who can build trusted client relationships, guide decision-making, and maintain accountability across teams while balancing client value, delivery quality, commercial impact, and long-term scalability.

 Serve as the senior delivery leader for assigned client portfolios, building trusted relationships and ensuring delivery strategies are aligned to client business objectives.
 Own end-to-end delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent client implementations, including timelines, quality, scope, risks, dependencies, and executive stakeholder alignment.
 Lead and develop teams of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and delivery resources, creating clarity, accountability, and consistent execution across engagements.
 Establish and maintain strong delivery governance, including clear decision-making forums, escalation paths, change control, scope management, and portfolio health reporting.
 Guide clients and internal teams through delivery trade-offs, ensuring requests are assessed against scope, timeline, resourcing, commercial impact, and overall client value.
 Identify delivery risks proactively, resolve complex issues, and drive practical solutions that protect client outcomes and support long-term scalability.
 Own portfolio financial performance, including P&L, margin targets, revenue performance, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
 Create executive-level visibility into portfolio health, key risks, scope decisions, dependencies, milestones, and actions required to support successful delivery.

 Collaborate with the Sales, Support, Operations, and Product teams to improve handoffs, align expectations, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and strengthen the overall client experience.
 Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, playbooks, metrics, automation opportunities, and operating practices to increase consistency, efficiency, and predictability.
 Identify opportunities to expand client value while ensuring delivery commitments, scope considerations, and commercial implications are clearly understood.
 Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in client delivery, implementation, program leadership, or professional services within SaaS, technology, financial services, or a similarly complex environment
 Proven success leading complex client implementations and delivery portfolios with accountability for scope, timelines, quality, client satisfaction, and business outcomes
 Strong executive presence with the ability to build trust with senior client stakeholders, communicate clearly, guide decision-making, and lead productive conversations around priorities and trade-offs

 Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating across multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment
 Experience with project, portfolio, and resource management tools such as Jira, Kantata, or similar platforms

 The base salary range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. jobs.description:
About the Role 
 iCapital is looking to hire a Vice President to join the Corporate Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, SEC Reporting, this individual will be a key leader across building out the firm’s SOX controls readiness program as well as focus on iCapital's technical accounting programs. This role combines hands-on experience with business process controls and IT general controls (ITGCs), public-company reporting and governance requirements, and complex U.S. GAAP technical accounting matters. This individual will partner closely with other members of the Corporate Finance, Corporate Development, Technology, Legal and Compliance, Human Resources and Benefits teams. This role also works with outsourced advisors for technical accounting and tax, external auditors, and other business leaders to build scalable, audit-ready processes and help prepare the organization to operate like a public company.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead key workstreams within the firm-wide SOX program, including risk assessment, scoping, control design, documentation, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, remediation, and executive reporting.
 Provide subject matter expertise across both business process controls and ITGCs, including the evaluation of control dependencies, automated controls, system-generated reports, and key interfaces.
 Help design and execute the organization’s path to SOX compliance, including readiness planning, external auditor coordination, evidence standards, testing strategy, and sustainable program governance.
 Partner with process and control owners to develop and maintain process narratives, flowcharts, risk and control matrices, and other control documentation.
 Identify control gaps and process improvement opportunities, develop practical remediation plans, and drive issues through timely and sustainable resolution.
 Provide periodic reporting to senior management, including the CAO and CFO, on SOX readiness, testing results, remediation status, emerging risks, and key decisions.
 Lead and support initiatives across accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, governance, and SEC reporting capabilities.
 Prepare and review technical accounting memoranda for complex and judgmental matters, including business combinations, asset acquisitions, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, consolidation, capital raising activity and other transactions.
 Research and assess new accounting standards and SEC developments, determine their impact, and coordinate implementation across relevant stakeholders.
 Develop and maintain accounting policies that translate U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements into clear, scalable operating practices.
 Support financial statement preparation and review, including U.S. GAAP and SEC disclosure requirements, as needed.
 Mentor team members and strengthen technical accounting, controls, project management, and executive communication capabilities across the organization.
 Qualifications 
 8+ years of progressive public accounting, internal controls, financial reporting, or technical accounting experience
 Public accounting experience is required  
 CPA license is required
 Demonstrated experience testing or evaluating internal controls at a public company, including both business process controls and ITGCs
 Experience helping a company prepare for or complete its first year of Section 404(b) auditor attestation is strongly preferred
 Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, PCAOB standards, and public-company internal control expectations
 Able to research complex accounting matters, develop well-supported conclusions, and prepare clear technical accounting memoranda
 Financial services, fintech, asset management, wealth management, or alternative investments experience is preferred
 Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs, influence senior stakeholders, prioritize competing demands, and drive workstreams to completion
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical matters into concise, decision-oriented recommendations
 Highly organized and detail-oriented and able to connect detailed execution to broader business objectives
 Benefits 
 The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $175,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).
 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role
 The Site Reliability Engineering team at iCapital is fundamental to ensuring our platform delivers consistent, reliable service to our client base. Our services run on Kubernetes in AWS, and this role focuses on keeping them healthy in production.
 We're looking for the hands-on engineer others turn to when production is broken and the cause isn't obvious. You'll troubleshoot across the full stack (the application, its containers, Kubernetes, and the underlying cloud infrastructure) and turn what you learn into lasting improvements: stronger reliability standards, safer rollouts, sharper alerts, and automation that prevents repeat failures. You'll rely on metrics, logs, and traces every day, but the heart of this role is diagnosing and fixing what they reveal.
 Responsibilities
 Act as a senior escalation point for complex production issues in Kubernetes-based services, leading hands-on investigation across application, container, Kubernetes, and AWS layers through to root cause.
 Partner with the teams that own our cluster infrastructure to resolve platform-level issues, and feed what you learn back into reliability standards and improvements.
 Define and implement reliability and operability standards for Kubernetes-based services, including resource sizing, health checks, scaling patterns, rollout safety, and baseline monitoring, as part of service onboarding.
 Serve as Incident Commander or senior technical lead for high-severity incidents, lead postmortems, and drive systemic improvements through action items and measurable follow-through.
 Turn recurring investigations into runbooks, diagnostic tooling, and automated remediation that shorten time to resolution and eliminate toil.
 Coach engineers in systematic troubleshooting and Kubernetes best practices through reviews, game days, and knowledge sharing.
 Define, implement, and iterate service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs) that reflect customer and business expectations.
 Standardize monitoring and alerting through “monitors as code” (Terraform preferred), including quality gates such as severity, ownership, and runbook links.
 Operate and tune OpenTelemetry pipelines, including sanitizing data, managing cardinality, and enriching telemetry with consistent fields.
 Maintain the infrastructure behind our monitoring stack, including Helm charts, ArgoCD ApplicationSets, Kinesis streams, Lambda functions, and Prometheus.
 Participate in on-call rotations with a focus on improving reliability, reducing alert noise, and increasing signal quality over time.
 What You'll Need (Must-Haves)
 5+ years in SRE or related roles, with evidence of technical seniority across multiple services and teams.
 3+ years of hands-on experience running and troubleshooting production workloads on Kubernetes, with a deep understanding of how Kubernetes schedules, connects, scales, and rolls out workloads.
 Proven ability to independently diagnose complex failures in distributed systems running on Kubernetes, spanning application, configuration, resource, networking, and scaling issues, including cases where the root cause wasn't obvious.
 Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, with the ability to troubleshoot below the container layer.

 As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact.  The Team 
 Upstart’s Partnerships team helps drive customer acquisition and originations through partner offers. The team is focused on improving how offers are optimized across the customer journey.

You’ll take on a greenfield optimization opportunity, moving from research and measurement to production-ready models and decision strategies.
 How you’ll make an impact 
 Develop causal machine-learning models to optimize customer offers at different points in the funnel, from marketing-time decisions with limited information to decisions informed by customer activity on our site.
 Analyze and interpret complex data, identify gaps in what we know, and design experiments to gather evidence for building and evaluating optimization models.
 Measure the impact of offer changes with statistically rigorous experiments and evaluations.
 Translate research and results into clear recommendations, decision strategies, and next steps for business and technical partners.
 Build production-ready models and code for use in offer selection.
 Partner with Partnerships leadership, Product, Engineering, peer machine-learning teams, and model-risk partners to align on strategy, implementation, and methodology.

 Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
 2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.
 Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied-science or data-science context.
 Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
 Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 PhD in a quantitative field.
 Experience with marketplace optimization, particularly where pricing or offer decisions are central.
 Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
 Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
 Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production-model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
 Ability to translate broad business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
 The Role 
 We are currently seeking a full stack software engineer to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll join a full-stack team of engineers and collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver client-facing features that will set us apart from our competitors. 
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B , F-1 /OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.
 What You’ll Do 
 Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and key clients to define and deliver  solutions that support and streamline user workflows
 Work alongside senior software engineers to deliver features end to end, with strong opportunities for ownership
 Coordinate with our web platform and design system teams to ensure our product is a seamless part of the Addepar user experience
 Engage in the budding inner-source culture within Addepar, fostering standardization across the myriad of React, terraform and Python codebases within the company
 Who You Are 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
 2+ years full-stack development experience OR
 1+ years experience with front end development technology
 1+ years backend development experience
 You care about delivering quality and value to clients in an agile manner
 Python or Java development experience a big plus
 Experience with React, web components, Svelte, and/or Ember a big plus
 Full-stack, product engineering experience a big plus
 Experience with gen AI for coding a plus
 Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.
 Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.
 Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
 Base Salary Range
 $114,000 — $178,000 USD 
 Our Values  
 Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.  
 Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.  
 Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.  
 Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.  
 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 
 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The ideal candidate will play a senior leading role in implementing, maintaining, and strategically evolving Addepar’s Production Infrastructure.. You will bring a robust combination of leading innovative solutions across functional teams and extensive hands-on development experience in AWS/cloud, Linux/Unix, networking, advanced scripting abilities, containerization, Kubernetes, Terraform, Information Security, deep debugging, and comprehensive monitoring/observability skills. This includes designing, deploying, monitoring, automating, and optimizing all operational aspects of Addepar's platform with a focus on reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of container infrastructure using Kubernetes (k8s), ensuring high availability, performance, and security
 Build, and maintain advanced, automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, ArgoCD, AWS CodeBuild/Pipeline, GitHub Actions, or similar, establishing best practices for deployment strategies (e.g., blue/green, canary)
 Drive the adoption and evangelism of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles using Terraform, focusing on scaling the Addepar Platform across regions with a focus on cost optimization and operational efficiency

 Perform advanced monitoring and troubleshooting of our infrastructure and application stack using a wide array of logging/monitoring tools, driving root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures
 Initiate and lead collaborations with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve complex Application or infrastructure issues, serving as a technical subject matter expert
 Serve as a primary on-call responder for critical incidents, demonstrating strong problem-solving skills under pressure and contributing to post-incident reviews to improve system resilience
 Who You Are 
 Extensive experience of progressive experience in the SRE/DevOps/Systems Engineer field, with a track record of taking on increasing responsibility
 Expert-level understanding of Cloud Infrastructure fundamentals (AWS preferred), including advanced networking, security, and managed services
 Exceptional Programming/Scripting skills in various common languages (Python , Bash, and general Linux tools are essential; Java is a strong plus), with an emphasis on building scalable, maintainable automation and tools
 Broad expertise with UNIX/BSD/Linux internals (Ubuntu preferred), including performance tuning, kernel-level debugging, and advanced system administration
 Extensive Containerization experience with k8s (KOPS, EKS, ECS preferred), including cluster management, custom resource definitions (CRDs), and advanced deployment strategies
 Proficient experience with comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, Sumologic, or advanced AWS cloud-native tools, with a focus on observability strategy
 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate with multi-functional teams, articulate complex technical concepts, and influence outcomes
 Demonstrable experience writing and contributing to significant systems automation tooling or open-source projects is a strong plus
 Exposure to industry practices in financial services is a plus

jobs.title: Director, Brand Design
jobs.description:
About Betterment 
 Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings, and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors, as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We're headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
 About the Role 
 Betterment is entering its next phase of growth, and we’re looking for a Director of Brand Design to raise the ambition and craft of our brand everywhere it shows up.
 This role is for someone who obsesses over the kerning in a web nav as much as over the motion piece that moves people. You have exceptional  taste, a sense of curiosity to learn new things, and a strong point of view. You’ll be the brand’s primary design voice and the final word on our brand design system, knowing when to hold the line and when to evolve. You will make the brand feel like one brand across advertising, web, motion and sales collateral, for both our Retail and B2B businesses.
 You’ll stay hands-on. You’ll lead concepting and art direction on our biggest initiatives and shape them from the first idea. You’ll polish the work that matters most and jump in wherever the craft needs you. You’ll also lead and develop a small team of  designers, setting the bar for their work and trusting them to own execution in their areas. Stakeholders will come to you for creative direction, not just review.
 Reporting to the VP, Brand Creative, you’ll partner closely with our Director of Copy and our Director of Brand Operations. 
 This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 
 New York City: $175,000-$205,000
 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus. 
 A Day in the Life 
 Act as the arbiter of our brand design system and standards; challenge the system when it starts to feel stagnant and keep a constant eye on how our visual identity needs to evolve.
 Review and shape creative briefs before work begins, ensuring projects start with clear direction and objectives. 
 Hold the overall craft bar across advertising, web, motion, and collateral. Lead concepting and art direction on key initiatives, personally refining work at critical moments, and catching any execution misses or inconsistencies.
 Manage and develop a team of senior designers: set clear goals, deliver regular and constructive feedback, and push design execution from good to great. 
 Build and pitch proposals for new design initiatives.
 Work closely with marketing and sales stakeholders on assignments to understand goals and what success looks like.
 Create a team culture where designers feel empowered to take creative risks, raise dissenting opinions, and learn from projects that don't land perfectly the first time.
 Represent your team's work and point of view to senior leadership, translating creative decisions into business context.
 Participate in hiring: lead portfolio review interviews, evaluate candidates, and help scale the team as it grows.
 Source and direct vendors and agencies to supplement our work.
 What We're Looking For 
 10+ years of brand/design experience, including experience leading or managing designers.
 A strong, well-defined point of view on brand design systems, with experience evolving an identity system over time rather than just applying one.
 Proven ability to translate business strategy, objectives, and growth goals into a clear creative point of view and compelling work, while shaping creative briefs and providing direction before execution begins
 Experience managing and developing designers at varying levels of seniority, including supporting both craft-focused and people-leadership growth paths.
 A strong track record of partnering cross-functionally with copy and brand voice, marketing, operations, and external agencies to keep creative work on-brand and on schedule.
 Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to represent your team’s work and decisions to senior and executive stakeholders.
 A portfolio that demonstrates range and craft across advertising, web, motion, and sales materials.
 Bonus points if you have experience:
 Working in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated industry, given the compliance and disclosure requirements that shape our creative work.
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process. 
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this informat

jobs.title: Associate - Middle Office & Digital Operations
jobs.description:
About Clear Street:  
 Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.
 We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.
 For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io .
 The Team 
 You will join the Operations division, supporting clients and business stakeholders across our traditional (equity and fixed income) and digital assets businesses. You will be a first point of contact for trade processing, settlement and reconciliation across both.
 The Role 
 Perform daily trade capture, confirmation and allocation for equities and fixed income.
 Process and confirm settlements across equities, fixed income and digital assets. Handle counterparty settlement requests and trade and settlement queries within agreed timeframes.
 Reconcile trades, transfers, positions and inventory daily across internal systems and external exchanges, custodians, banks and nostro accounts. Investigate and resolve breaks to closure.
 Monitor inventory and funding needs for settlement activity, and coordinate cash and asset movements with Treasury.
 Investigate and resolve regulatory reporting items.
 Manage the monthly and quarterly Broker Confirmation processes.
 Partner with the Trading Desk, Product, Client Service, Accounting, Risk and Compliance. Provide accurate, timely trade and settlement data, and inputs that help design pragmatic controls in a changing regulatory landscape.
 Assist in building new applications and help test during integrations.
 Track and deliver against operations KPIs, and follow processes designed for regulatory compliance.
 Escalate issues promptly, document procedures, and contribute to process improvement and automation as the business scales.
 Requirements 
 2–5 years in trade operations, middle office or settlements at a broker-dealer, trading firm, hedge fund, investment bank or digital assets firm.
 Strong knowledge of equity and fixed income trade processing and the full trade lifecycle (execution, confirmation, allocation, settlement, reconciliation), including what it takes to close a break.
 Exposure to digital asset operations, such as on-chain transfers, wallet operations, exchange and custodian workflows, or stablecoin settlement, and genuine interest in the space.
 Experience with allocation platforms, Omgeo Central Trade Matching and the FIX protocol.
 Experience working with large data sets and spreadsheets. You can reconcile across multiple systems and spot discrepancies quickly.
 Self-motivated, extremely organized, and highly accurate when handling asset movements and client-impacting processes.
 Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to escalate the right issues at the right time.
 BA/BS degree in Finance or a similar major.
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with reconciliation or post-trade tooling.
 Experience at a prime broker, clearing firm or other regulated institution, with exposure to derivatives and regulatory reporting.
 Experience building or documenting operational procedures in a fast-growing business.
 We Offer:  
 The Base Salary Range for this role is $95,000-$110,000. This range is representative of the starting base salaries for this role at Clear Street. Where a candidate falls in this range will be based on job related factors such as relevant experience, skills, and location. This range represents Base Salary only, which is just one element of Clear Street's total compensation. The range stated does not include other factors of total compensation such as bonuses or equity.
 At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office 4 days per week. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.
 Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Bilingual English and Spanish Member Loyalty Representative (R14343)
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 
 The Opportunity 
 Oportun is currently seeking qualified candidates with customer service, cashier, sales, or hospitality experience to work Fulltime. At Oportun, we consider our customers to be our members, and the primary focus of our Member Loyalty Representatives is to create and generate a rewarding and unique member service experience. 
 Our Member Loyalty Representatives are passionate about listening, helping, and connecting with people at all touchpoints, such as in our stores and in the communities around our stores through personal outreach activities. As a key member of our team, you will make the mission of Oportun come to life by educating our members and communities about our inclusive, affordable financial services that empower them to build a better future. 
 At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 
 What You'll Do 
 Your day-to-day 
 Welcome members with a warm greeting and provide quality member service. 
 Seamlessly process all transactions, while following company policies & procedures and protecting our members’ information. 
 Work as a team or independently, including time alone in the store without direct supervision or with coworkers, while exceeding daily goals in our lending and servicing activities. 
 Enjoy informing and educating potential members about Oportun’s services by engaging in outreach efforts more than 50% of the time at Oportun locations, partner locations and/or community events. Activities include: 
 Building relationships with local businesses (e.g., mechanic shops, dental offices, furniture stores) and speaking with local business owners and their employees about how Oportun’s services can help their customers. 
 Conducting outreach efforts at local flea markets, community events, and at our Lending As A Service (LAAS) partner locations to increase awareness, capture leads, and assist with starting applications; 
 Actively engaging with people at and around Oportun’s retail locations, encouraging store visits, and assisting with applications. 
 Supporting community outreach and marketing events, by passing out flyers and educating the local community about Oportun and its products and services; and 
 Using iPads or assisting potential members with scanning QR codes during outreach efforts to start new applications. 
 Light housekeeping to keep the work area and store location inviting and presentable to all who visit, including daily collection of trash, sweeping, mopping, and window cleaning as needed. 
 Use a computer intermittently (approx. 3-6 hours per day) for administrative tasks and for servicing members. 
 Stand while assisting members; sitting is allowed during non-member-facing tasks. 
 Occasionally unpack and store office or cleaning supplies. 
 Must have the ability to travel between designated work locations (including outreach activities) within a reasonable commuting distance as part of standard job duties. Travel will be limited to sites considered part of an ordinary commute. 
 Be a role model for Oportun’s Core Values: On a Mission, As One, to Make it Better, Now. 
 Who You Are 
 The right fit looks like this 
 You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. 
 Must be outgoing, sales-focused, and enjoy speaking with people. 
 Must love to help members, including prospective members through outreach and educational activities. 
 What You Bring 
 Skills & experience 
 Required 
 Must be bilingual (English/Spanish). 
 Must be available to work weekends and be flexible with a rotating work schedule of hours based on store needs. Schedules are set every two weeks. 
 Must have regular, reliable, and predictable attendance to support store operations. 
 Must be willing and able to work outdoors year-round to identify new sales opportunities and promote company products and services through designated outreach activities. 
 Ability to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds, as needed. 
 Basic computer skills and ability to operate office equipment such as, phones, scanners, and iPads. 
 Ability to organize and file paper documents. 
 Compensation 
 The base hourly rate for this part-time position is $17.00 - $18.00. 
 Our hourly rates are determined by role, location and experience. The hourly range displayed on each job posting reflects a minimum and maximum for new hire rates for this position, specific to the location of this job posting. 
 Please note that the compensation details listed in this posting reflects only the hourly rate for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits. 
 Why Oportun 
 What's in it for you 
 Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 
 Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 
 As a Valuable Member of Our Team, You’ll Receive 
 EAP, Life and Disability insurance 
 Accident coverage 
 8 paid hours (VTO) to participate in volunteer activities each year 
 Employee Assistance Fund (OEAF) 
 401(k) retirement savings 
 Travel Assistance 
 Paid Training 
 Competitive pay, plus sales incentives $$$ 
 Growth opportunities 
 Flexible schedules 
 Opportunity to positively impact your community 
 This is a summary of select benefits and does not represent the full benefits package. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers 
 Our AI Mindset 
 We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 
 AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 
 We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 
 In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . 
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. 
 California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . 
 We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

 Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an interest in learning emerging AI technologies and infrastructure.
