jobs.title: Senior Payroll Tax Specialist
jobs.location: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
 Our Global Payroll team is at the foundational stage of building a world-class global payroll ecosystem, and it's a great time to join! We partner closely with Corporate Tax, Corporate Engineering, Accounting, Benefits, Legal, and Global Mobility to make sure employees are paid accurately and on time. We build systems and processes that scale across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles. We also work hand in hand with external payroll and tax providers, and we expect strong accountability on both sides. Ethics and accuracy sit at the center of how we work.
 As a Senior Payroll Tax Specialist, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Global Payroll and serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary operational contact for our external providers. You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.
 This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 
 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.
 What you'll do
 Own withholding tax configuration in Workday, including setup, mapping, and maintenance of state, local, and international tax tables, and partner with Corporate Engineering to test changes in sandbox before production release.
 Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M&A activity.
 Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers.
 Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements.
 Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities.
 Manage agency notices and new tax account setups, act as the point of contact for third-party providers, and deliver reporting and liability analysis to Finance, Accounting, Corporate Tax, and People Operations.

jobs.description:

 The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.
 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.
 This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week .
 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

 Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
 Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
 Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
 Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
 Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling

 A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, TIFIN @Work
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 
 TIFIN builds the AI operating layer for wealth. Our platform delivers agentic workflows across the industry’s core personas—investors, advisors, investment teams, and operations—so financial institutions can move faster, serve more clients, and deliver better outcomes with the same (or fewer) resources. We combine finance-native AI, specialized data, and enterprise-grade controls to deploy secure, compliant capabilities into real production environments.
 WHAT SETS US APART 
 Speed: We build and ship quickly—MVPs in ~3 months, production-ready products in ~6–12 months.
 Track Record: Prior exits include 55ip (acquired by J.P. Morgan) and Paralel Technologies
 Strategic Partners: Partners include J.P. Morgan, SEI, Franklin Templeton, Morningstar, FactSet, Broadridge, Motive Partners and Tectonic Ventures.
 World-Class Team: Complimentary expertise across AI and financial services, with experience from Google, Microsoft, Uber, PayPal, eBay, BlackRock, LPL, Franklin Templeton, Morgan Stanley, Broadridge and more. 
 OUR VALUES 
 Grow at the Edge. We are driven by personal growth fueled by a beginner’s mindset. We get out of our comfort zone and keep egos aside. With self-awareness and integrity we strive to be the best we can possibly be. No excuses.
 Understanding through Listening and Speaking the Truth. We communicate with authenticity, precision and integrity to create a shared understanding. We identify opportunities within constraints and propose solutions in service to the team.
 I Win for Teamwin.  We believe in staying within our genius zones to succeed and taking accountability for driving results. We are all individual contributors first and always thinking about what can be better.
 TEAM & ROLE OVERVIEW 
 TIFIN @Work is the AI-native platform for the workplace. We connect payroll, benefits, retirement plan, and outside account data (225+ HR and payroll systems today), and on top of that we run a platform of AI agents: an orchestrator that routes each question to specialists for things like 401(k) contributions, health plan selection, equity comp, debt, and emergency savings, and that knows when to hand a person to a human advisor. Employees get guidance that’s actually personal to their paycheck and their plan. Advisors get signals on who to talk to and why. For the wealth management firms we sell to, that turns their retirement plan business into a growth engine.
 We’re a small team split across the US and Spain. We value being physically together to collaborate more and move faster so we are in-office, every day. We ship in short cycles, do real design reviews, test properly, and change how we build as the models change.
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to own the architecture of our AI agents. You will design the multi-agent workflows that answer real financial and benefits questions for real people, build the evaluation system that tells us whether those answers are good, and make sure every number the agent gives can be traced back to its source. You will have real autonomy over what gets built, working directly with the product and client-facing teams.
 WHAT YOU’LL OWN 
 The multi-agent system at the heart of the product. You’ll design and build production workflows where planners and specialized agents coordinate, call tools, stream responses, pause for human input, and recover reliably from checkpoints.
 The quality engine that proves it works. You’ll create the evaluation system—from adversarial test sets and execution-trace scoring to calibrated LLM judges, CI regression gates, production monitoring, and a published quality score.
 A retrieval system clients can trust. You’ll turn complex financial and benefits documents into grounded, cited answers using hybrid search, reranking, and thoughtful chunking—with a clear evidence trail behind every number.
 A personalized agent that is fast, safe, and reliable. You’ll build the context layer that determines what each agent knows and may use, while improving security, latency, and cost through scoped permissions, validation, prompt caching, and intelligent model routing.
 WHO YOU ARE 
 You want your work to matter in the real world. You have shipped agentic AI to real users and are motivated by building systems that help people make better financial decisions. You understand orchestration, state, checkpointing, and streaming—not just prompts and notebooks—and you’ve gone deep with LangGraph or a similar framework.
 You know quality has to be proven. You’ve built evaluation systems that test real behavior: benchmarks and golden datasets, execution-trace scoring, LLM-as-a-judge calibrated against human labels, and offline and online evaluations including A/B tests. They catch regressions and block bad releases. You use tracing and observability tools such as LangSmith, Phoenix, or Langfuse to connect production outcomes back to development and create a clear feedback loop for what the team should improve next.
 You have real machine learning depth behind the engineering. You’ve fine-tuned or distilled small language models for narrow tasks such as classification, routing or extraction, using techniques like LoRA, QLoRA and quantization, and served them with inference stacks such as vLLM, TGI or SGLang, weighing accuracy against latency and cost. 
 You know trust must be designed into the system. You know that in high-stakes financial products, every answer and action needs to be reliable and explainable. You’ve built production RAG systems using chunking, hybrid search, reranking, vector stores, grounding, and citations. You make tool calls and structured outputs reliable with Pydantic or JSON Schema, treat prompts and tool contracts as versioned and tested artifacts, and understand how to protect PII before data reaches an external model.
 You believe great engineering is about making the right trade-offs. You’ve shipped with more than one model provider and can choose between them based on quality, speed, cost, and reliability. You’re strong in Python and comfortable moving across the stack, from FastAPI or Django to React, TypeScript, data infrastructure, and the cloud. You explain your decisions clearly in writing and design reviews, and you review your teammates' designs and merge requests with the same rigor you apply to your own.
 You believe the best builders keep reinventing how they build. You experiment with new models, agent patterns, and AI-native development tools, then turn what works into better products and faster workflows. You use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to raise your ambition and output without lowering the bar. You’re excited to push further into areas like fine-tuning and serving open-weight models, MCP and tool-protocol design, and generative UI, turning promising new capabilities into dependable products.
 COMPENSATION RANGE 
 $150,000 - $200,000 USD, competitive and appropriate to experience level
 In addition to cash compensation, a meaningful equity stake is a significant part of the overall package. Package also includes benefits program eligibility, which includes 90-100% medical, vision and dental coverage for you and your dependents, retirement benefits and flexible PTO. See our Careers page for more details.
 TIFIN is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and values the multitude of talents and perspectives that a diverse workforce brings. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Ally and Your Career 
Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?
 Work Schedule : Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.
 The Opportunity 
This role will be responsible for executing key components of the Technology Risk and Controls Assurance program, including independent control testing, issue validation, and risk reporting for the Technology Business Line Testing team. The role will work closely with multiple stakeholders including Ally Technology and Cyber leadership, IPRM, business leaders, and technology project and operations teams to conduct technology and cybersecurity risk assessments, interpret data and analytics outputs, and lead control remediation and uplift efforts.
 The Work Itself 
 The Work Itself Partner with Ally Technology and Cyber Leaders working cross-functionally while conducting individual control tests
 Independently develop, complete, and document tests in accordance with Ally policies and procedures and industry best practices
 Interpret data literacy and analytics outputs — including automated testing results and control monitoring dashboards — to identify anomalies, assess sample adequacy, and provide consultation to management regarding emerging control practices
 Participate in uplift initiatives will be essential to the function's contribution to the enterprise and its continuing role within Ally business
 Proactively identify emerging risks and remain informed of emerging risk trends and industry-leading mitigation practices
 Complete assigned validations of findings and issue management activities with quality and in accordance with Ally standards
 Contribute to control uplift initiatives, special projects, and continuous improvement efforts that strengthen control operations, reduce deficiencies, and support evolving regulatory and cybersecurity expectations.
 Provide coaching, guidance, and support to team members and contractors, as needed.
 Apply current cybersecurity risk assessment practices in control testing, consistent with evolving industry and regulatory baselines
  The Skills You Bring 3+ years of work experience in audit, assurance, or equivalent line of service; technology/cyber focus strongly preferred
 Bachelor's degree or comparable combination of education and experience
 Working knowledge of technology control frameworks (e.g., FFIEC, NIST SP800-53, CRI Profile, etc.)
 Relevant certification (CIA, CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CPA, etc.) is a plus
 Detail-oriented, deadline driven, self-directed and organized individual
 Desire to creatively identify problems that potentially were not known to exist and provide solutions and/or recommendations
 Strong written and verbal communications skills
 Ability to work with structured datasets and dashboard/reporting tools (e.g., Excel-based data models, Power BI, or similar) to interpret testing results and identify control exceptions — direct coding or scripting experience not required
 Proven ability to excel in highly interactive team environment
 Working knowledge of GRC Platform (e.g., Archer) and Microsoft Office applications
 Minimum Qualifications 
 3+ years of experience
 High school Diploma or GED equivalent
 How We'll Have Your Back 
Ally's compensation program offers market-competitive base pay and pay-for-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including:
 Time Away: Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part-time status and management level).
 Planning for the Future: plan for the near and long term with an industry-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access.
 Supporting your Health & Well-being: flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short- and long-term disability, pre-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially.

jobs.description:
Data Product Analyst
 Location: Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)
 The Opportunity
 We’re looking for a Data Product Analyst to help transform business needs into trusted, usable data products that power reporting, analytics, and better business decisions. In this role, you’ll help bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data products are thoughtfully designed, well-documented, and built to solve real business problems.
 You’ll have the opportunity to contribute throughout the data product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering to testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement. If you’re curious about data, enjoy solving problems, and like bringing people together to turn ideas into action, this is an opportunity to build your expertise while making a meaningful impact.
 How You’ll Make an Impact
 Translate Business Needs into Actionable Requirements: Partner with business stakeholders to understand their goals, reporting needs, workflows, and data challenges. Document requirements and translate discovery findings into clear user stories, development tickets, and acceptance criteria.
 Support Data Product Design and Development: Collaborate with Data Product leads, reporting teams, and data engineers to define data needs, business rules, definitions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
 Build Trusted Product Documentation: Write and maintain product requirements documents (PRDs), data contracts, business definitions, and usage guidance. Partner with Data Governance and engineering teams to document data structures, quality expectations, ownership, and refresh requirements.
 Validate Data Products and Deliver Quality: Use basic SQL and reporting tools to explore data, investigate discrepancies, and validate results. Prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business participation, document defects, and confirm fixes meet acceptance criteria.
 Strengthen Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate requirements, proposed designs, testing results, and product demonstrations to technical and business audiences. Keep partners informed of open questions, issues, and progress.
 Identify Opportunities for Improvement: Monitor product usage, performance, and user feedback to identify issues and opportunities to make data products more accurate, accessible, and useful.
 Who You’ll Work With
 You’ll work closely with Reporting, Data Governance, and Data Product leads, business stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers to bring data products from discovery through delivery. This is a collaborative, cross-functional role where you’ll help connect business priorities with technical execution, build shared understanding, and ensure the products we deliver are trusted and useful. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn from experienced partners as you deepen your understanding of our data ecosystem and product practices.
 What You’ll Bring
 A college degree.
 At least two years of experience working alongside data or analytics teams in a business, analytical, technical, or product support capacity.
 Basic SQL skills, including the ability to query, filter, join, and summarize data.
 Experience working with databases or reporting and business intelligence tools.
 Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear, organized documentation.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business audiences and communicate business needs to technical teams.
 A collaborative approach to working with stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers.
 Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to organize work and follow through on open items.
 What Will Help You Thrive
 Hands-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering.
 Experience writing user stories, development tickets, acceptance criteria, or product requirements documents.
 Experience supporting user acceptance testing or validating reports, datasets, or data pipelines.
 Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data quality, business definitions, ownership, lineage, and data contracts.
 Experience using tools for project tracking, documentation, or data cataloging.
 Curiosity about how data products are designed, developed, governed, and used to solve business problems.
 Comfort using AI tools to support discovery, requirements gathering, data product design, prototyping, and documentation, while validating outputs for accuracy and ensuring responsible data use.
 Experience designing or building AI agent workflows and automations to streamline tasks, connect tools or data sources, and support business processes.
 A proactive mindset, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate open questions and evolving requirements.
 What Success Looks Like
 Business needs are clearly captured and translated into actionable requirements, user stories, and development tickets.
 Data products are well-documented, with clear definitions, ownership, usage guidance, and quality expectations that help business users understand and trust the data.
 Testing identifies issues early, discrepancies are resolved collaboratively, and delivered products meet agreed-upon acceptance criteria.
 Business and technical partners stay aligned through clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, and timely follow-through.
 Product usage and stakeholder feedback inform improvements that make data products more valuable, accessible, and effective.
 Location & Work Arrangement: This position is based in Charlotte, NC, and requires attendance at our South End office three days per week.
 Work Authorization: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.
 Life at LendingTree
 We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that’s curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You’ll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed.
 We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You’ll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together.
 And while we work hard, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work — our GSD (Get Stuff Done) Award is a fan favorite — and make time to have some fun along the way.
 Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what’s next.
 The #1 Destination to Shop for Financial Products

You’ll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together.
 And while we work hard, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way.
 Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what’s next.
 What We Offer
 We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you.
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 401(k) matching
 Generous time off
 Wellness programs and resources
 Annual performance bonus eligibility

The Senior IT Systems Administrator at NerdWallet is responsible for maintaining the stability, scalability, and security of the organization's technology infrastructure.  - Set objectives, bidding strategy, audience approach, budget allocation, and conversion events per campaign

 - Manage campaigns end-to-end: setup, QA, pacing, troubleshooting, optimization

 - Build testing plans for new verticals, bidding strategies, conversion events, creative angles, and funnel experiences

Optimization & Performance

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

 - Review assets for clarity and platform fit; give feedback through concept, script, and production stages

 - Build creative testing roadmaps and turn results into next-round recommendations

 - Evaluate landing pages and funnels for message match, conversion flow, and drop-off

 - Recommend and support tests across landing pages, advertorials, lead forms, quizzes, and pre-qualification flows

 - Ensure creative, landing pages, and tracking are aligned before launch



Platform Partnerships & Competitive Research

 - Manage relationships with platform reps; evaluate their recommendations against NerdWallet's goals and data quality

 - Track competitor creative, offers, and funnel approaches; feed insights back into strategy
   
   

Your experience:

 - 5+ years of paid search experience, ideally in lead generation.

 - Proven track record of utilizing AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate marketing functions, gain data insights, and optimize creative processes.

 - Forward-thinking vision regarding how and where to market in the age of AI and video, demonstrating the ability to craft tactics for finding consumers as search behaviors shift beyond standard search engines.

 - Demonstrated experience in video marketing, with a track record of driving performance through short-form video content, emerging ad formats, and platforms like YouTube to capture audiences outside of traditional Google Ads.

 - Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Proven track record scaling paid search (7 figures in monthly spend preferred) while maintaining or improving CPA/CAC and ROAS.

 - Experience managing toward lead gen, revenue, ROAS, CPA/CAC, or funnel-based goals.

 - Ability to build paid media strategy from the ground up — structure, testing, measurement, creative, optimization.

 - Strong analytical skills, comfortable with both platform and backend business data.

 - Experience troubleshooting tracking, attribution, or reporting discrepancies.

 - Experience writing creative briefs and giving feedback to creative teams or external partners.

 - Strong project management skills across multiple concurrent verticals and workstreams.

 - Clear, confident communicator who can translate data into recommendations for non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in financial services (insurance, lending, wealth, banking, investing, mortgage, home equity, or other regulated categories)

 - Experience optimizing toward backend events — funded loans, booked appointments, matched leads

jobs.title: Sales Trainer (Scottsdale, AZ)
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we're on a mission to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Every small business has a unique story, and we're passionate about helping entrepreneurs access the financing they need to start, grow, and succeed. As part of our Small Business Sales team, you'll play a critical role in developing the sales professionals who make that mission possible.

We're looking for a Sales Trainer who is passionate about developing people, elevating sales performance, and building a culture of continuous learning. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role where you'll partner closely with Sales Leadership to onboard new Account Executives, coach existing team members, and reinforce the sales behaviors that drive exceptional customer outcomes.

You'll spend time where it matters most—embedded with the sales team—observing live customer conversations, facilitating coaching sessions, analyzing performance trends, and helping representatives sharpen their consultative selling skills. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy helping others succeed, and love translating coaching into measurable business impact, we'd love to meet you.



WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

As a Sales Trainer, you'll serve as a trusted partner to Sales Leadership while helping representatives build the confidence, skills, and product knowledge needed to succeed.

This role is approximately 70% new hire onboarding facilitation and 30% ongoing sales coaching. You'll:

 - Lead an engaging onboarding program that prepares new Account Executives to confidently navigate customer conversations, master our sales process, and achieve ramp expectations.

 - Deliver ongoing coaching through live call observation, call reviews, role plays, deal strategy sessions, objection-handling exercises, and pitch refinement.

 - Maintain a consistent presence on the sales floor, identifying coaching opportunities and providing timely, actionable feedback that improves performance.

 - Reinforce NerdWallet Small Business's Challenger-based and consultative sales methodology throughout every stage of the customer journey.

 - Coach representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency creation, lender positioning, financing education, ROI articulation, follow-up strategy, and closing execution.

 - Become a subject matter expert on small business financing, alternative lending solutions, borrower profiles, lender programs, and deal positioning.

 - Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Business Development, Product, and Operations to ensure onboarding and coaching remain aligned with business priorities, market trends, and product updates.

 - Analyze call recordings, coaching observations, and performance metrics to identify recurring skill gaps and develop targeted coaching plans.

 - Create and continuously improve practical enablement materials including playbooks, talk tracks, call examples, role-play scenarios, and job aids.

 - Support frontline sales managers by reinforcing coaching best practices and driving consistency across teams.


WHERE YOU CAN GROW:

At NerdWallet, learning doesn't stop after onboarding. As a Sales Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to influence the development of an entire sales organization while partnering closely with leadership to shape coaching strategy, improve onboarding programs, and continuously raise the bar for sales excellence. You'll build strong cross-functional relationships, expand your expertise in sales enablement, and directly contribute to the growth of both our people and our business.




YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - 1+ years of experience in sales training, sales enablement, sales coaching, or frontline sales leadership within a fast-paced, quota-driven organization.

 - A proven track record of onboarding new sales representatives and improving speed to productivity.

 - Experience coaching sales professionals through live observation, call reviews, role plays, and direct feedback.

 - A strong understanding of Challenger, consultative, and transactional sales methodologies.

 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.

 - The ability to deliver direct, actionable coaching while building trust and credibility across the sales organization.

 - Experience using sales and enablement technologies such as Gong, Salesforce, LMS platforms, or similar tools.

 - A data-driven mindset with the ability to connect coaching activities to measurable improvements in sales behaviors and business outcomes.

 - Willingness to travel approximately twice per quarter to support in-person onboarding, training, and coaching.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience selling or coaching within small business financial services, alternative lending, merchant cash advance (MCA), fintech, or another high-volume transactional sales environment.

 - Formal certification or experience with recognized sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or MEDDICC.


HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU'RE SUCCESSFUL

Success in this role will be measured by the impact you have on the development and performance of our sales organization. You'll help new hires ramp more quickly, improve the quality of customer conversations, strengthen sales execution, increase conversion rates and funded revenue, reduce recurring performance gaps, and build a culture where coaching is an everyday part of winning.




WHERE:

 - This role is Full-time in office and will be based in Scottsdale, AZ.

We have found that working in-person, alongside peers and more senior members of the team, confers great advantages owing to the spontaneous learning and collaboration opportunities that arise daily on a sales floor and that cannot be easily replicated in a remote environment.

We also understand the importance of flexibility to work remotely, both for personal and professional reasons. While this is an in-office role, as long as you are meeting our minimum performance standards, you’ll have the option to work remotely 20% of the month from anywhere in the continental US starting after you complete training, typically between months 4-6.




WHAT WE OFFER:

Pay Transparency: $85,000 - $117,000 base + equity

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

 - Mental health support

 - Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

 - Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

 - Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

 - Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

 - Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

 - Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

 - Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Overview: 
 We are a rapidly growing B2B payments fintech headquartered in Charlotte, NC. Our mission is to revolutionize payment solutions for businesses, fostering innovation, efficiency, and scalability. We’re proud to partner with industry-leading organizations to bring best-in-class solutions to market. 
 We’re looking for a passionate and consultative Solution Consultant to support our Direct and Channel Sales organizations. In this role, you’ll be a critical technical and strategic bridge across our direct sales teams, channel partner networks, and prospective clients—ensuring seamless solution architecture, exceptional sales execution, and accelerated revenue growth. 
 What you'll do: 
 Sales Enablement & Support: Partner directly with internal Account Executives and external clients, delivering technical guidance, product expertise, and strategic enablement to drive deal velocity. 
 Consultative Selling: Collaborate across Direct and Channel go-to-market teams to understand prospect business needs, architect tailored B2B payment and AP automation solutions, and articulate clear value propositions. 
 Client & Partner Engagement: Drive technical discovery, solution scoping, product demonstrations, and architecture deep dives on joint sales calls alongside direct and channel Account Executives. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the feedback loop between field sales (Direct and Channel) and internal Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams to align client requirements with product roadmaps. 
 Solution Expertise: Maintain expert-level knowledge of our product portfolio, market trends, ERP/accounting system integrations, and competitive offerings to position our platform effectively. 
 Technical Problem-Solving: Act as a trusted technical advisor, proactively overcoming technical or workflow objections to advance opportunities through the sales funnel. 
 What we're looking for: 
 Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in consultative solution consulting, pre-sales, or technical sales engineering role—preferably in B2B payments, fintech, or enterprise software. 
 Consultative Mastery: Exceptional consultative selling, discovery, and relationship-building skills across executive, financial, and technical stakeholders. 
 Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into compelling business value. 
 Domain & Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of AP/AR processes, financial back-office workflows, ERP ecosystems, payment platforms, and API integrations. 
 Collaboration & Execution: Self-motivated, highly collaborative, and capable of managing multiple active deal cycles in a fast-paced remote/hybrid environment. 
 Education & Travel: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). Ability to travel 15–20% domestically as needed for key prospect and partner meetings. 
 About AvidXchange
 AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange,  mindset is everything . We are Connected as People , Growth Minded , and Customer Obsessed . These three mindsets represent our culture – who we are, who we’ve always been, and they guide us to improve every day. Since our founding in 2000 in Charlotte, NC, we’ve created a company of over 1,300 teammates working across the U.S., or remotely. AvidXchange is proud to be Certified™ as a  Great Place to Work ®. The prestigious recognition is based on anonymous data from our teammates and makes official what our teammates have known for years – that AvidXchange is a Great Place to Work®. 
 Who you are:  
 A go-getter with an entrepreneurial mindset – that means you are not afraid of taking risks, winning big or facing the unknown. 
 Someone who understands that business is people centric. Connecting with others as humans first allows you to develop mutually beneficial working relationships. 
 Focused on making a difference for our customers. AvidXchange exists to help solve complex problems for our customers so we can all realize our potential. 
 What you’ll get:  
 AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. We help our AvidXers develop as professionals and as human beings, providing work/life balance, development programs, and competitive benefits. At AvidXchange, we are building more than a tech company – we are building an experience. We remain committed to a culture where you can fully be 'you’ – connected with others, chasing big goals, and making a meaningful impact. If you want to help us grow while realizing your potential and creating stories you’ll tell for years, you’ve come to the right place.
 AvidXers enjoy:   
 18 days PTO* 
 11 Holidays (8 company recognized & 3 floating holidays) 
 16 hours per year of paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) 
 Competitive Healthcare 
 High Deductible Heath Plan Option that has $0 monthly premium for teammate-only coverage 
 Dental Base Plan Coverage
 100% AvidXchange paid Life Insurance 
 100% AvidXchange paid Long-Term Disability 
 100% AvidXchange paid Short-Term Disability  
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Provides counseling services, legal and financial consultations and health advocacy for Teammates and their eligible dependents
 Onsite Health Clinic with Atrium Health - available to Teammates and their eligible dependents
 401(k) Match: 100% match on the first 3% of your salary, plus 50% match on the next 2%
 Parental Leave: 8 weeks 100% paid by AvidXchange** 
 Eldercare Leave: 8 weeks at 100% pay to care for a qualifying family member***
 Discounts on Pet, Home, and Auto insurance 
 Onsite gym fitness center, yoga studio, and basketball court
 Gym reimbursements for remote teammates up to $28/month 
 Tuition Reimbursement up to the federal maximum of $5,250***
 Hybrid Workplace Flexibility
 Free parking
 *Fully granted from beginning of year, pro-rated if hired mid-year  
 **Must be full-time for at least 3 months 
 ***Must be full-time for at least one year  
 Equal Employment Opportunity
 AvidXchange is an equal opportunity employer. AvidXchange is committed to equal employment opportunity in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. AvidXchange will not discriminate against applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis. This includes, but is not limited to veteran status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age and physical or mental disability.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
The Company You’ll Join
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
 For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .
 The Problems You’ll Solve 
 At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As the Business Development Manager for Carta Law, you will manage our relationships with law firms, investment banks, compliance consultants and other business partnerships globally.
 You will expand Carta’s distribution and market share by helping us deepen working relationships with key channel partners—and developing relationships with new ones. You'll be responsible for identifying, structuring and growing partnerships that drive distribution of Carta Law's services - turning law firms, investment banks and compliance consultancy firms from potential competitors into active referral partners and collaborators. 
 The Team You’ll Work With 
 You'll be joining the Carta Law Sales team in London or Americas offices. Our team manages the full client lifecycle - from welcoming new clients through onboarding, to building deep, lasting relationships with established fund managers and their legal teams.
 We sit at the intersection of legal delivery, commercial strategy, and operations. Day-to-day we partner closely with our legal delivery team, sales, marketing, and operations to ensure clients get maximum value from Carta Law and that we're well-positioned to grow with them over time. We're building the gold standard for client success in the AI-powered legal services space, and you'll have a meaningful hand in shaping what that looks like.
 About You 
 If you have a background in law or legal services, understand how private markets firms and their advisors operate and are energised by the commercial side of the industry, this role is for you.
 Experience in or building partnership channels via law firms, asset management firms or professional services firms preferred. (Ideally from scratch)
 Strong understanding of the private markets ecosystem — PE, VC, credit, real assets — and how legal and compliance workstreams operate within it
 Experience managing senior relationships and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
 Commercially sharp, with the ability to structure and close partnership deals
 Excellent communicator — confident presenting to partners, General Counsels and C-suite stakeholders.
 Proactive and self-directed; comfortable building something from the ground up
 Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot preferred)
 Represent Carta in the field, meeting with current and prospective partners and attending industry events on Carta’s behalf (up to 25% travel)
 Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot preferred)
 Salary 
 Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) for this role is: 
  $225,000 OTE in New York City,  NY 
 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors.
 Disclosures:
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email. 
 Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.
 For information on our data privacy policies, see  Privacy ,  CA Candidate Privacy , and Brazil Transparency Report .
 Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

 Lead a multi-quarter roadmap for nurture, campaigns, newsletters, and follow-up journeys. Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect growth goals to audiences, messages, offers, and next steps.

 Measure conversion, pipeline, opportunities, and revenue alongside engagement, audience health, and deliverability. Turn results into clear recommendations for leadership on strategy, creative, targeting, and investment.
 Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Marketing to develop and optimize adoption, cross-sell, and upsell programs as core email priorities.

 As part of the Navan Core and Navan Signature Global Learning Team, you will represent learners and the Learning and Development team on key global projects. You will contribute to the learning strategy and roadmap, then design and deliver the learning content and activities within your scope. You will own the development of learning materials, support training delivery as needed, and maintain the learning management system.

 Partnering with learning content administrators and business stakeholders to build and deliver engaging new hire curricula and learning pathways for existing colleagues. Tailor learning to different learner profiles and business priorities, helping new hires reach competency efficiently without compromising quality.
 Developing and maintaining learning content, supporting training delivery as needed, and keeping the learning management system and learning portfolio up to date. Coordinate stakeholder reviews and sign-off before content is published.
 Working with the wider Learning and Development team and standards trainer to shape content plans and establish consistent formats and frameworks for learning across regions and delivery settings, including remote, hybrid, and in-person learning.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Navan Expense is an expense and corporate card solution that eliminates the hassles of expense management while giving finance leaders real-time spend visibility and control. Navan Expense provides employees with a refreshingly easy way to pay for what they need while giving finance leaders one easy place to control, manage, and track spend. With physical and virtual cards, smart policy management, and automated expense reports, Navan Expense streamlines the entire business spending process — driving cost-savings, productivity, and compliance.
 We’re looking to bring on a Solutions Consultant, Expense who will continue to scale Navan Expense and the future of this product line. You will partner closely with our Sales, Product, Finance, Support and Operations teams, all the way up to our C-Suite - to ensure we are delighting our clients and exceeding goals.
 You will be a key player in helping Account Managers expand Expense product offerings within current strategic travel accounts, implement the Expense solution, and increase adoption within the Commercial segment by combining your expertise of accounting and finance with your knowledge of our expense management platform and corporate credit card. Navan Expense has currently seen 10x growth in the last year and is currently being used by 800+ companies, such as Epicor, Loom, Toast & Lyft. By understanding client needs and leveraging your knowledge, you will help assist with an effective strategy that will ultimately drive revenue. The Ideal Candidate will be a subject matter expert with an accounting and finance background who is looking to be a leader of their career as they become the foundation of a growing team while joining a global, multi-product, multi-market SaaS company. 
 What You'll Do: 
 Develop a strong understanding the value proposition and inner workings of the Navan expense and payments solution
 Apply your accounting/ finance industry knowledge and Navan Expense Management solution expertise to implement our Expense solution and to help clients realize the benefits of our product

jobs.title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Email is one of the most direct ways we connect with prospects and customers—and this is your opportunity to lead it. On the Digital Demand Gen team, you’ll have the ownership to set the strategy, the creative freedom to try new approaches, and the hands-on role to bring them to life. If you want to see your ideas translate into stronger engagement, pipeline, and revenue, this role puts that impact within reach.
 Based in San Francisco, this senior individual-contributor role spans prospect nurture, pipeline generation, customer adoption, cross-sell, and upsell. 
 What you’ll do
 Lead a multi-quarter roadmap for nurture, campaigns, newsletters, and follow-up journeys. Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect growth goals to audiences, messages, offers, and next steps.
 Partner with Marketing Operations on the email calendar; own what goes out and when. Prioritize competing requests so each contact gets relevant, valuable content at the right time without being overwhelmed.
  Align campaign owners on priorities and timing, communicate tradeoffs, and push back constructively on requests that dilute the audience experience.
 Set the creative bar for concepts, copy, and design. Use briefs and performance insights to guide reviews and coach Creative and Campaign partners toward useful, distinctive, on-brand emails.
 Build, QA, and optimize modular emails in Knak, including personalization and reusable components. Create templates, workflows, and QA standards for consistent execution. Marketing Operations owns technical setup and sending; review their work and flag targeting, automation, tracking, or delivery issues.
 Grow and protect the reachable prospect database. Partner with Marketing Operations on acquisition, segmentation, automation, deployment, deliverability, consent, and suppression.
 Lead testing across audiences, offers, messages, formats, cadence, and timing, prioritizing experiments by business impact and learning value.
 Measure conversion, pipeline, opportunities, and revenue alongside engagement, audience health, and deliverability. Turn results into clear recommendations for leadership on strategy, creative, targeting, and investment.
 Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Marketing to develop and optimize adoption, cross-sell, and upsell programs as core email priorities.
 What we’re looking for
 5+ years leading B2B SaaS email, demand generation, or growth programs, with ownership of multi-quarter roadmaps and measurable pipeline or revenue impact.
 Deep hands-on Knak experience and enough technical fluency in segmentation, automation, tracking, and deliverability to review send setup and recognize when something isn’t working.
 Strong creative and editorial judgment; you can improve messaging, concepts, and execution beyond the initial brief.
 Strategic, analytical thinking across audience growth, experimentation, database health, and performance tied to business outcomes.
 Strong cross-functional influence and clear communication with leadership. You can align stakeholders, make tradeoffs, push back constructively, mentor teammates, and drive accountability.
 Nice to have 
 Working knowledge of Marketo, Salesforce, or similar marketing systems.
 Experience with customer adoption, cross-sell, or upsell, or email across multiple segments, regions, or products.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager (Travel/Energy & Marine)
jobs.description:
The Specialty Travel and Events team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead development for Energy & Marine Travel. In this role, you will shape the travel experience for customers whose teams work across remote locations, offshore environments, and global operations. These travel needs involve complex itineraries, crew movements, changing schedules, and time-sensitive disruptions. You will turn those challenges into a reliable, intuitive product experience.
 You will own this product area end to end, connecting customer and business needs with scalable product and engineering solutions. You’ll build a deep understanding of how energy and marine organizations manage travel, identify where the current experience falls short, and set a product direction that works for travelers, travel managers, and the teams supporting them.
 If you thrive on complex problems, high accountability, and close collaboration across global teams, this role is for you.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Become the Expert: Work closely with your design and engineering counterparts, internal business owners, and industry experts to understand the needs of energy and marine travel. Build expertise in the workflows and constraints that shape travel to remote and offshore locations, including crew movements, complex itineraries, and operational changes.
 Own the Lifecycle: Lead the product experience across booking, trip changes, traveler support, administration, reporting, and internal servicing tools. Find ways to make travel easier to plan and manage before, during, and after a trip.
 Solve complex product and systems problems: Identify gaps across workflows, data, and architecture. Partner with engineering to build dependable products that can support the unique requirements of energy and marine customers at scale.
 Drive Vision & Execution: Define a clear product strategy and roadmap that leverages AI to produce better outcomes and experiences, not to slap “AI” on every solution. Turn customer and business needs into focused product plans, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and deliver improvements at a pace that supports a growing customer base.
 Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate daily with your Product, Design, Engineering, and Go-To-Market teams to move products from ideation through to launch.
 Data-Driven Accountability: Set meaningful KPIs and rigorously measure your team’s success. You use data to navigate ambiguity and provide clear, thoughtful documentation for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Ownership Mindset: You take full accountability for your space. You are a self-driver who dives deep into complex problems and takes pride in "owning it" from start to finish.
 Experience: Minimum 5+ years of Product Management experience at a software company, specifically working on user-facing applications with high backend complexity.
 Technical Fluency: Ability to grasp complex engineering intricacies and simplify them for others. You understand technical dependencies and can speak the language of your engineering counterparts.
 Stakeholder Obsession: You are a relationship builder who anticipates the needs of internal subject-matter experts and external customers alike.
 Domain Expertise: Experience in corporate travel or finance tools, marketplaces, payments, procure-to-pay, or highly regulated industries is a major plus.
 Global Mobility: Travel to our offices in San Francisco and Berlin is required to foster collaboration with our global teams.
 Seriously Fun: It’s a company value – really! We work hard and have a ton of fun while doing it.

jobs.description:
Brand Manager, Marketing Effectiveness 
 Location: London Contract: Full time, permanent
 Team description 
 Central Brand & Marketing builds the campaigns, trackers and insight that show whether SumUp's marketing actually works, across six markets and two very different audiences: consumer and business owners. This role sits at the centre of that picture, turning tracker data into targets, forecasts and recommendations that media, creative and the wider business act on, and taking the lead on a new competitive insights hub that will become the company's source of truth on competition and market performance. It's a chance to shape how SumUp reads its market from the ground up, working closely with the Media & Strategic Partnership, Creative, Growth, Sales and Operations teams along the way.
 What you'll do 
 Run SumUp's consumer and B2B brand trackers across six markets, keeping the data accurate and the targets realistic
 Turn tracker results and market insight into clear recommendations that shape campaigns, pricing and sales conversations
 Own upper and mid funnel campaign reporting with the Media team, then share what worked and why with other marketers
 Build and launch a new competitive insights hub that becomes the single place the business goes for market intelligence
 Track vendor deliverables and contracted rights so partnership data and trackers are fully used, not left on the shelf
 What you'll bring 
 Experience in brand management, brand marketing or market research, gained in an agency or in-house team.
 Solid understanding of brand tracking and how to measure upper and mid funnel campaign performance.

jobs.title: Financial Products General Ledger Team Lead
jobs.description:
Financial Products General Ledger Team Lead 
 Sofia, Bulgaria | Permanent, office-first 
 Take a look inside our Sofia office 
 Team description 
 The Financial Products General Ledger (FGL) team sits at the strategic core of SumUp's financial operations. We own the financial integrity of SumUp's financial products (payment services, issuance of electronic money), ensuring every euro of revenue and cost from our payments, merchant business accounts, banking and cash advance lending products is accurately captured, reconciled and reported.
 As SumUp scales, our work has become highly analytical and data-driven. We combine deep accounting knowledge with SQL, AI-assisted reconciliation tools and advanced data analytics to understand not just what was recorded, but why and how our business operates financially.
 This leadership role is the owner of the European FGL team. You will lead a team of 6 people, own the quality and timeliness of the e-money and PSP close, and drive the automation and controls that will support our IPO-readiness.
 What you'll do 
 Lead a team of 6 accountants, setting clear expectations, priorities and workload distribution.
 Coach team members on complex reconciliations, accounting judgment calls and month-end routines; support their professional growth and foster a culture of precision, curiosity and continuous improvement. 
 Work on subject matter that covers the core activities of regulated business in the Fintech industry - payment processing, issuance of electronic money and cash advances, characterized by complex financial transactions and big data sets.
 Map the accounting flow for new products and ensure correct treatment before launch.
 Lead the audit and year-end close readiness, with timely responses to auditors. 
 Communicate complex accounting issues clearly to non-finance stakeholders and escalate facts and impact when needed. 
 Own the documentation and continuous improvement of process governance (Desktop Procedures, Process Maps), internal controls systems and key performance indicators.
 You'll be great for this role if... 
 Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in multiple accounting domains, including reconciliations, general ledger management and IFRS financial reporting, ideally in an international company. 
 Prior experience leading an accounting team.
 ACCA certification required (or near completion).
 You want to understand why discrepancies happen and how to prevent them. 
 You can drive root-cause analysis and systematic improvements across multiple reconciliations and entities.
 You lead through influence, coaching and clear communication. 
 You are motivated to drive automation, controls and process improvement in a fast-growing fintech. 
 You want to understand how the business works, not just record what happened. 
 Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERP systems.
 Experience with with data tools such as Snowflake, BI or Tableau is a plus.
 Why you should join SumUp 
 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup 
 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 
 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 
 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 
 🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options 
 🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance 
 💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities 
 🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform 
 🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station 
 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 
 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
 About SumUp 
 Be empowered to do more that matters.
 At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
 Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
 SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and TikTok .

jobs.title: Senior AML Investigator
jobs.description:
Senior AML Investigator
 📍  Sofia, Bulgaria  (Office-first)
 Team description
 As part of the AML Operations Team, you'll be one of the silent protectors keeping SumUp and its millions of merchants safe from financial crime, investigating flagged activity before it can turn into real harm. You'll dig into transaction patterns and customer behaviour to catch potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and other illicit activity, working closely with colleagues across the business to land on the right call. If you want a role where sharp attention to detail genuinely protects people and the business, this is where you'll find it.
 📽  Take a look inside our Sofia office 
 What you'll do
 Investigate transactions and accounts flagged by the transaction monitoring system to assess potential risk
 Analyse transaction patterns and customer behaviour to identify signs of money laundering or other financial crime
 Document investigation findings clearly and work with colleagues across the business to reach a final decision on suspicious activity
 Keep up to date with AML regulations and industry best practice, applying them in day to day investigations
 You'll be great for this role if
 At least 1–2 years of experience in AML investigation and financial crimes reporting or a similar field.
 A strong understanding of AML regulations, financial products, and services.
 Proven ability to conduct data analysis and complex investigations.
 Proficiency with technical tools like Microsoft Excel and other data analysis software.
 Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
 Strong communication skills, with excellent command of spoken and written English.
 A proactive and adaptable team player who can thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment.
 A quick learner with the ability to quickly grasp and apply new policies and procedures.
 Why you should join SumUp
 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup 
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

 Minimum 2-4 years of experience with Android development in Kotlin and/or Java, with hands-on experience shipping production Android apps

 Android app built in Java & Kotlin running in the restaurant

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 Toast is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise Data Loss Prevention and Secure Access Service Edge capabilities. The role will reduce data exfiltration risk, enable secure access to web, SaaS, private applications, and cloud services, and improve security coverage.
 You will be a senior individual contributor and subject matter expert, within the Enterprise Security team and will closely partner with IT, Network Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and application owners. Success requires hands-on engineering, design, operational ownership, and clear risk communication.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities) 
 Data Loss Prevention Engineering 
 Own the DLP engineering roadmap and control lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through proof of concept, testing, phased deployment, tuning, operations, and continuous improvement.
 Design and operate controls for sensitive data across managed endpoints, email, web and network channels, SaaS and collaboration applications, cloud environments, and data repositories.
 Build and maintain data discovery and classification logic using sensitive information types, regular expressions, data matching, document fingerprinting, OCR, and machine learning where appropriate.
 Translate requirements into precise policies and response actions with documented exceptions.
 Establish safe policy rollout practices with test cases, pilot groups, change control, user impact analysis, exception review, and measurable acceptance criteria.
 Triage and investigate DLP alerts and incidents, determine root cause and business context, coordinate containment and remediation, and reduce false positives without weakening protection.
 Integrate DLP with SASE services, SIEM/SOAR platforms, MDM, ticketing systems, data classification, data security posture management, and relevant response workflows.
 Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, control effectiveness, detection precision, recurring exfiltration paths, policy exceptions, incident volume, and time to resolution.
 Secure Access Service Edge Engineering 
 Engineer and operate scalable SASE capabilities for corporate fleet, SaaS, private apps, and cloud environments.
 Configure and optimize core capabilities including secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, zero trust network access, firewall as a service, DNS security, remote browser isolation, DLP, digital experience monitoring, and SD-WAN or SSE integrations.
 Manage traffic steering and connectivity patterns such as endpoint clients, browser or proxy configurations, private application connectors, IPsec or GRE tunnels, and branch or cloud on ramps.
 Lead phased migrations from legacy VPN, proxy, and perimeter security solutions while maintaining service continuity, policy consistency, and a reliable end-user experience.
 Create context-aware access and data protection policies using device posture, application risk, destination, data sensitivity, and session risk signals.
 Develop TLS inspection standards, certificate deployment practices, bypass criteria, privacy safeguards, and documented exception processes in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
 Monitor availability, latency, tunnel and connector health, service edge performance, and policy impact; troubleshoot access and application performance issues across endpoint, network, and cloud layers.
 Design for resilience through regional failover, redundant connectivity, configuration standards, observability, tested recovery procedures and controlled automation.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.
 Experience: 7+ years of experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility in enterprise security engineering environments.
 DLP engineering: Ability to architect, deploy, tune, and operate at least one major enterprise DLP platform, with strong knowledge of data discovery, classification, content inspection, endpoint controls, cloud and SaaS coverage, policy actions, exceptions, investigations, and metrics.
 SASE engineering: Ability to design, implement, migrate, and operate at least one major SASE/SSE platform. Practical knowledge of SWG, CASB, ZTNA, FWaaS, traffic steering, TLS inspection, connectors, and performance.
 Vulnerability management: Experience assessing, prioritizing, tracking, and validating remediations
 Developer and automation mindset: skills in Python, or a comparable language. Working knowledge with REST APIs, automation platforms, and AI-assisted dev tools such as Claude, Copilot, Codex or similar.
 Communication: Excellent communication skills and sound judgment.
 Preferred (Bonus) Skills 
 Education: Master's in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related discipline.
 Security operations integrations: Experience integrating security controls with platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Torq, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, or comparable observability and automation tooling.
 AI security and automation: Experience applying AI to improve security detection, policy engineering, investigation, or operational efficiency, and familiarity with controls for enterprise generative AI usage.
 Security frameworks: Working knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and zero trust principles, with the ability to translate requirements into operational controls.
 Governance platforms: Familiarity with ServiceNow GRC, Optro, or similar governance platforms.
 Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Security+, Network+, cloud security, or SASE/DLP vendor certifications.

jobs.title: Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As a Compliance Associate on the AML/CTF Compliance team, you'll help execute the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing programs for Coinbase Custody International, the CBIE Trust, and Coinbase Bermuda, ensuring Coinbase meets its regulatory obligations under the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2010 (as amended), Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) requirements, and the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act. This team protects Coinbase's customers and licenses by maintaining robust AML/CTF controls, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting across these entities.
