jobs.title: Spécialiste AirCover, Expérience client en réclamations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.
 La communauté que vous rejoindrez :  
 L’équipe AirCover a pour mandat de concevoir, de bâtir, de lancer et de gérer les activités d’AirCover au sein d’Airbnb. Nous avons une grande responsabilité envers notre communauté d’hôtes et de voyageurs : être là lorsque les choses ne se déroulent pas exactement comme prévu avec leurs réservations. Les défis seront nombreux au cours des prochaines années, et nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour nous aider à coordonner nos priorités et à offrir une expérience irréprochable à notre communauté.
 L’équipe Claims Experience fait partie de l’équipe AirCover. Elle offre un soutien haut de gamme à nos utilisateurs en adaptant l’expérience et les services proposés à leurs besoins particuliers, afin que chacun puisse accueillir des voyageurs et voyager en toute confiance. Nous cultivons une compréhension et une empathie profondes envers les attentes de chacun de nos clients, et nous allons au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.
 L’équipe assure la réussite opérationnelle de l’ensemble des produits AirCover et offre une exécution sans faille grâce à la qualité et à la rapidité de nos échanges, tout en veillant à la fidélisation de la clientèle et à la croissance continue de notre communauté Airbnb.
 La différence que vous ferez : 
 Vous aurez pour mandat de comprendre les besoins uniques de nos clients et d’aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.
 Vous traiterez nos clients avec cohérence, équité et empathie, de sorte qu’ils se sentent écoutés et compris. Vous adapterez le soutien offert à leurs besoins particuliers afin de régler les problèmes efficacement, à la satisfaction de toutes les parties. En améliorant l’expérience client de bout en bout, vous contribuerez à accroître les taux de fidélisation et à permettre à chacun d’accueillir des voyageurs et de voyager sur Airbnb en toute confiance.
 Une journée typique :  
 Évaluer, examiner et régler les réclamations soumises pour les produits AirCover (y compris, sans s’y limiter, les réclamations liées à la protection des hôtes contre les dommages), notamment des réclamations de valeur élevée et de grande complexité qui exigent des enquêtes approfondies et des négociations pour en arriver à des résultats satisfaisants
 Surveiller de près les indices de fraude et atténuer les risques associés aux individus malveillants afin de protéger la marque Airbnb et sa communauté
 Vérifier tous les faits et éléments de preuve pertinents pour déterminer l’issue de chaque dossier, dans le respect des politiques et des processus internes
 Aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées et offrir un soutien haut de gamme exceptionnel tout au long du processus de réclamation, en adaptant l’expérience proposée et en veillant à répondre aux besoins et aux préférences de chaque utilisateur avec le plus grand soin et la plus grande attention
 Renseigner et guider continuellement les utilisateurs au sujet de nos produits, de nos conditions et de nos politiques AirCover afin de faciliter le règlement de leurs demandes
 Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les administrateurs de réclamations tiers afin de s’entendre sur les stratégies de traitement des dossiers et d’assurer un règlement rapide pour nos utilisateurs
 Communiquer régulièrement avec les superviseurs et le gestionnaire pour faire le point sur l’état des réclamations
 Maintenir un haut niveau de confidentialité pendant les enquêtes
 Cerner les lacunes dans les processus, les méthodes de travail ou les politiques, et transmettre des commentaires aux échelons supérieurs au besoin afin d’améliorer continuellement l’expérience de nos clients
 Agir à titre d’expert ou d’experte en la matière pour les initiatives de changement et les projets interfonctionnels de l’organisation Aircover Scaled Ops and Optimization, notamment en aidant les parties prenantes internes à mettre à l’essai, à peaufiner, à concevoir et à déployer de nouveaux produits et processus internes
 Votre expertise : 
 5 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le secteur de la technologie financière (fintech) ou dans un rôle axé sur l’expérience client, dont au moins 1 an en traitement de réclamations d’assurance, idéalement des réclamations pour dommages matériels, tant de l’assuré que de tiers
 Esprit critique et capacité éprouvée à résoudre des problèmes clients complexes et à rendre des décisions d’indemnisation de façon cohérente et équitable, dans le respect des modalités des polices et des processus établis
 Excellentes communication à l’oral et à l’écrit, et expérience des échanges avec la clientèle par divers canaux, dont le courriel, la messagerie et le téléphone
 Écoute active afin de cerner les besoins des utilisateurs et de leur offrir des recommandations et de l’aide personnalisées
 Capacité d’expliquer avec assurance et clarté des enjeux complexes et délicats aux clients
 Capacités analytiques, sens de l’organisation et capacité de travailler de façon autonome dans un contexte où les priorités changent rapidement
 Habiletés de négociation pour régler les problèmes des clients rapidement et efficacement
 Orientation vers les solutions et les résultats, avec la capacité d’équilibrer la prévention de la fraude et une expérience utilisateur positive
 Calme et empathie, avec la capacité de s’adapter à toute situation en personnalisant les réponses et en renseignant notre communauté, tout en gardant son sang-froid dans les situations difficiles
 Un horaire de travail régulier de 5 jours par semaine (40 heures), établi d’un commun accord avec votre superviseur, qui inclut des fins de semaine ainsi que des jours fériés, y compris ceux de l’entreprise. Déplacements (s’il y a lieu)
 Expérience de la conduite d’initiatives de changement ou de projets interfonctionnels visant l’atteinte d’objectifs stratégiques
 Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes internes et des administrateurs tiers pour régler des réclamations complexes de façon rigoureuse, efficace et rapide
 Une maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit; la connaissance de toute autre langue constitue un atout.
 Votre emplacement : 
 En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail.  Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de déve

jobs.title: Supervisor - Trust and Safety Operations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join 
 Fraud & Safety Delivery (FSD) is at the heart of keeping Airbnb safe for the millions of hosts and guests who trust our platform every day. As part of Global Operations, FSD reviews and resolves potential fraud and safety cases across the full user lifecycle, with internal and partner specialists operating 24/7 across the globe.
 You'll join Frontline Operations, the pillar that does that review and resolution work. Our specialists and the partner teams who deliver alongside us handle cases around the clock, and the leads, managers and analysts across the pillar make sure that work is fast, accurate and consistent wherever it runs.
 You'll lead a team on Fraud & Safety Review within Frontline Operations, working day to day with Policy, Product and the partner sites that carry cases alongside your team.
 The Difference You Will Make 
 You lead a team of Fraud & Safety Review specialists: you decide how their work is prioritised as volume, risk and resourcing move through the week, and you coach the judgement that makes their decisions consistent whoever handles the case.
 The difference you make is a team that performs to a high standard all the time — not only when volume is manageable. That reliability is what the rest of FSD plans around.
 Success looks like a team that consistently meets its quality, service-level and resolution-time targets, fewer repeat escalations because a change is applied the same way by everyone, and specialists who stay and grow because the path in front of them is clear.
 A Typical Day 
 Lead and develop a team of Fraud & Safety Review specialists, holding the team accountable for quality, timeliness, and service goals while championing their growth and overall team engagement.
 Adapt the team's plan and make the day-to-day decisions on case handling, escalation and coverage as volume, case mix or resourcing shifts. For example: rebalancing the queue and re-cutting coverage when a surge in account-takeover reports lands on a public holiday with half the team off.
 Coach and develop your specialists through regular 1:1s and case reviews, manage performance against targets, and model the values and belonging behaviours that make the team people stay.
 Use judgment and the operational data to resolve the technical, customer and operational problems your team raises, and recommend the process and tooling improvements the pattern points to.
 Take process, tooling and workflow changes as an input from the broader fraud and safety strategy and land them with your team, and hand off the cases that need executive escalation or new precedent to the appropriate senior stakeholder.
 Watch your team's operational metrics, report the trends and risks in your remit to leadership, and anticipate resourcing needs so you can raise a gap to your manager before it becomes a blocker.
 Your Expertise 
 8+ years in Fraud & Safety, Risk, Trust or related operations, including 4+ years leading or supervising a team in a high-volume, time-sensitive case-review environment.
 Proven ability to hold a team of specialists to consistent quality, accuracy and productivity targets, using operational data to see where performance is moving and act on it.
 Working knowledge of fraud and safety typologies, and how workflow, precedent and policy interact on escalated cases.
 People leadership at the scope named above — led a team of specialists whose decisions carried real consequence, coaching a diverse group of talent and setting team priorities and performance targets.
 Sound operational judgment when the answer is not clear — you assess the situation, decide with the information you have, and adapt the plan rather than waiting for direction.
 Clear, direct communicator — able to make operational and case reasoning legible to your specialists, to your cross-functional partners, and to the leadership tracking your team's results.
 Experience in a marketplace, travel or platform fraud and safety environment, or building SOPs, playbooks and enablement that scaled beyond one team, is a plus, not a requirement.
 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
 How We'll Take Care of You:

The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. 
 As a Safety Threat Investigator on the Safety Investigations team, you will primarily support Roblox’s Core Investigations capability: the operational backbone for repeatable, high-sensitivity matters that require speed, consistency, evidence discipline, and strong documentation. You will independently manage small- to medium-scope investigations from intake through resolution, with little day-to-day oversight, and produce clear, defensible work product that supports high-confidence safety decisions.
 You will recognize when a matter needs deeper attribution, network-centric analysis, cross-platform research, proactive threat hunting, or externally meaningful work product, and you will escalate to a senior investigator or to Specialized Investigations. At the CL7 level, you will own your assigned investigations end to end, apply the team’s methods with consistency, and bring back practical observations that make the next case faster and clearer. You will check in with your manager or a senior investigator when scope, risk, or the right investigative lane is unclear.
 Please note: This role may require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. It may also require participation in an on-call rotation during weekends and holidays.
 You Will
 Independently manage repeatable, high-sensitivity investigations of small to medium scope, including matters involving child exploitation, violent extremism, organized fraud, compromised accounts, coordinated abuse, and other high-risk behavior.
 Apply structured investigative methods, evidence checklists, common templates, and approved data pulls to produce timely and consistent case outcomes.
 Gather, preserve, analyze, and corroborate evidence while maintaining accurate provenance, confidentiality, and auditability.
 Turn an assigned investigative question into a practical plan, including scope, evidence steps, milestones, and exit criteria, and seek review from a senior investigator when the matter is ambiguous or growing in complexity.
 Conduct focused account, entity, and timeline linkage within a case, and identify when the case needs deeper attribution, network mapping, or cross-platform investigation.
 Escalate to Specialized Investigations, or to a senior investigator, when a case develops meaningful attribution complexity, broader network risk, external actionability, or a need for deeper synthesis.
 Prepare clear case summaries and standardized downstream work product for partners such as Legal, Safety Intelligence, Trust & Safety Operations, Law Enforcement Operations, or NCMEC, as appropriate.
 Notice recurring patterns, operational pain points, and escalation trends in your caseload, and share them so they can inform Policy, Product, Engineering, Detection, Legal, and Safety Operations.
 Contribute to investigation playbooks, templates, intake guidance, and quality checks by testing them in casework and proposing specific improvements.
 Keep teammates informed with clear, timely updates, raise blockers early, and stay aligned with partners on the cases you own.
 Share practical techniques with peers, and incorporate feedback to strengthen your own investigative rigor and documentation.
 Maintain strong case hygiene, document decisions and approvals, and close investigations with clear outcomes, documented residual risk, and follow-up actions.
 You Have
 3+ years conducting investigations involving safety, abuse, fraud, security, threat, or other high-risk matters.
 Demonstrated ability to independently manage small- to medium-scope investigations end to end, including intake, evidence development, analysis, findings, and follow-through, with little day-to-day oversight.
 Working experience using SQL, spreadsheets, or similar tools, and open-source intelligence, in an investigative context.
 Sound investigative judgment and the ability to distinguish facts, inferences, allegations, unknowns, assumptions, and analytical conclusions.
 Familiarity with account or entity linkage, timelines, or open-source research, and the judgment to recognize when a case needs deeper attribution or specialist support.
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce concise, defensible case summaries for investigators and partner teams.
 Ability to turn a defined investigative question into a practical plan, adjust as new evidence appears, and deliver medium-scope work on time.
 A habit of connecting individual cases to policy, product, detection, and user-safety questions, and of sharing those observations with the team.
 Ability to collaborate with peers and partners, build working relationships beyond your immediate team, and take feedback from senior investigators.
 Sound judgment, discretion, curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to evidence-based, fair, and proportionate investigations.
 Success in This Role
 Within your first year, you will be expected to independently manage Core Investigations matters of small to medium scope from intake to completion, deliver consistent and defensible work product, escalate cases that need deeper or specialized handling, and contribute practical observations that help the team investigate more consistently.
 You will be successful when you:
 Deliver rigorous, timely, and consistent outcomes on the investigations you own.
 Apply sound judgment in triage, evidence development, escalation, and case closure, and ask for review when scope or risk is unclear.
 Use the team’s methods, templates, and quality standards consistently, and suggest specific improvements based on your casework.
 Surface recurring patterns from your investigations so partners can act on them.
 Communicate clearly with teammates and partner teams, and help peers by sharing what you learn in casework.
 Our Team Principles
 We follow the full story, investigate horizontally, make safety impact real, pursue accountability end-to-end, lead with mission and curiosity, collaborate with candor and respect, build leverage rather than relying on heroics, and continuously raise the bar.

 About the Role 
 The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
 You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
 Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence. 
You Will 
 Support health and proactive gap identification 
 Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
 Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
 Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
 Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc) 
 Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
 Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
 Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.
Knowledge & Support Content 
 Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
 Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on. 
 Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
 Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
 Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place
You Have
 7+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
 A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
 Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
 Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
 Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
 Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
 Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
 Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
 Data & Diagnostic Proficiency: Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.

 As a Software Engineer in our Creator Services Communication Pod, you will build the next generation communications plane to power the millions of experiences on the Roblox Platform.
 To give some examples of what we do, we run the mission-critical Cross-server Messaging Service , which is crucial for Roblox game developers to implement leaderboards, cross-server announcements, live operations and more. We own the developer APIs for HTTP calls to external systems and player teleports within and between game servers. We are also launching Compute Functions, which provide developers with a new surface to execute game logic for more robust features such as custom matchmaking, limited inventory drops, or any background task processing. To tie features like these together, we are building a general Game Server Management product to unify developers' observability and control of their servers.
 At its core, this team is focused on solving complex back end distributed systems and networking problems at scale. However, our scope extends to full stack projects spanning all the way from the infrastructure layer, through engine development, data pipelines, microservices, telemetry, game servers, web development, UI, and UX design. This team collaborates on multiple cross-company efforts and our projects are of extremely high importance to Roblox. If you enjoy working on modern distributed systems, products for developers, C# and C++ software, and networking challenges alongside highly-experienced and passionate engineers, you will be right at home on our growing Creator Services team.
 You Have 
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong ownership working in complex technical systems.
 Knowledge: You are comfortable working with systems level programming languages (C++, C#, Objective C, Rust, or similar programming language).
 Curiosity: You are eager to work across a wide range of systems and understand the Roblox ecosystem end to end
 Long-term Mindset: You are considerate of how your work impacts the team/users over time, not just getting the green checkmark on a deliverable
 You Will 
 You will develop new products and features that help creators make complex experiences including live game operations at many-million-player scale.
 You will support core systems at massive scale including how players move between game servers, how game servers communicate with each other, and how experiences interact with on and off platform services.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager I, Base Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.
 Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.
 The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.
 The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.
 Responsibilities:  
 As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:
 Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)
 Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions
 Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices
 Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio 
 Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams
 Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles
 Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.
 Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.
 Experience: 
 5+ years of product management or relevant experience, with significant time spent on algorithmic, data-driven, pricing, or marketplace products
 A deep technical understanding of microeconomics, and ideally a background in Operations Research, Econometrics, Machine Learning, or algorithmic systems
 Experience owning pricing, revenue management, or other economic levers with direct P&L impact; experience with price optimization, elasticity modeling, or cost modeling is a strong plus
 Experience running A/B tests and market-level experiments, using statistical and causal inference techniques to evaluate results, and developing post-launch testing strategies
 Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design
 Ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products, and excellent judgment about the dynamics of a product ecosystem
 Natural ability to make things happen around you; you manage ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies across many teams in an organized and structured way
 Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level — within teams, within the company, and with executives
 Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation
 Benefits: 
 Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
 Mental health benefits
 Family building benefits
 Child care and pet benefits
 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
 In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
 Subsidized commuter benefits
 Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Forecasting & Scenarios
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 The opportunity 
 Build the machine learning capabilities that help advertisers understand what they could achieve on Reddit and make better investment decisions.
 You will lead models that estimate how campaign outcomes could change with different budgets, bids, audiences, creative performance, or objectives. The work connects supply and demand forecasting, audience availability, response prediction, and marketplace simulation to help advertisers compare alternatives and recognize valuable opportunities they may be missing.
 This is a hands-on technical leadership role with ownership of modeling direction, evaluation standards, and reusable production capabilities across advertiser planning and recommendations.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead forecasting and scenario modeling. Translate advertiser questions into models of delivery, reach, performance, and investment tradeoffs. Set technical direction and guide execution across the team.
 Connect inventory, demand, and response. Combine forecasts of available advertising opportunities, audience activity, marketplace competition, and predicted response to estimate achievable delivery and performance.
 Estimate outcomes under alternative choices. Develop models that account for changes in budget, bid, audience, and optimization objective, including interactions among these choices, auction dynamics, and campaign constraints.
 Quantify unrealized opportunity. Incorporate creative-performance estimates from partner teams to assess how stronger creative could have improved campaign results. Translate those inputs into potential gains in delivery, efficiency, or advertiser value.
 Build models that generalize. Apply probabilistic forecasting, multitask learning, transfer learning, hierarchical modeling, or related approaches to handle sparse segments, cold start, delayed feedback, and changing conditions.
 Establish trustworthy comparisons. Evaluate numerical accuracy, calibration, uncertainty, and cohort-level performance. Define supported scenarios and identify when additional evidence or experimentation is needed.
 Close the learning loop. Compare recorded predictions with mature outcomes, diagnose systematic errors, and validate scenario estimates through experiments and observed results.
 Own production delivery and technical leadership. Partner with engineers on reliable training, serving, monitoring, and iteration. Lead designs, mentor engineers, and collaborate with Product, Data Science, Ads Delivery, Audience, and Creative teams.
 What we’re looking for 
 A track record of developing and shipping predictive ML systems in advertising, marketplaces, recommendations, search, demand forecasting, or similarly complex domains.
 Strong foundations in statistical learning, probability, and optimization, with experience modeling large-scale behavioral or transactional data.
 Depth in one or more relevant areas: probabilistic or hierarchical forecasting, calibrated conversion/value prediction, multitask or transfer learning, delayed-feedback or survival modeling, or response modeling .
 Strong judgment in evaluation, including temporal validation, calibration, segment-level performance, and the assumptions required to estimate outcomes under changed conditions.
 Experience addressing sparse observations, cold start, seasonality, distribution shift, selection bias, or partially observed labels.
 Strong programming and software engineering skills, including experience building and operating production ML systems.
 Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives, make practical tradeoffs, and develop other engineers.
 Preferred experience 
 Complementary depth in one or more of:
 Demand, supply, and inventory forecasting: Advertising inventory, marketplace demand, traffic, retail demand, or capacity forecasting. Relevant methods include probabilistic time-series models, hierarchical/global forecasting, external-signal modeling, and multi-horizon prediction.
 Auction and investment modeling: Auction simulation or replay, conditional win-rate and price models, bid/budget response curves, or constrained optimization.
 Scenario evaluation: Counterfactual or off-policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation, or composition of multiple predictive models.

jobs.title: Lead, Technical Services
jobs.description:
MongoDB is helping define the next era of application development as organizations modernize legacy systems, build AI-native experiences, and power mission-critical workloads across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. From MongoDB Atlas, our AI-ready developer data platform, to our industry-leading server technology and enterprise software offerings, MongoDB provides a flexible and unified software stack that helps customers build faster, scale with confidence, and support a wide range of modern application needs.
 Building on the rapid success and adoption of MongoDB, we are delivering applications and services that make it much easier to manage and scale database deployments. These next-generation systems are a growing list but currently include products such as Atlas, Cloud Manager, and Compass. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.
 We’re open to speak with candidates based in Sao Paulo.
 Life in MongoDB Technical Services 
 As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.
 Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.
 As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:
 Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
 Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations
 Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
 Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
 Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
 Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
 Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence
 What you need 
 The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:
 Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
 Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
 Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
 A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
 Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
 Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
 Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
 Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
 Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
 Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments

 About the Role
 The Core Licensing & Devices team owns the layer that turns Verkada's licenses into revenue: a double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles every license into daily revenue recognition. This is the system Finance closes the books on and the one auditors trace, so every entry has to be right. As Verkada scales past millions of devices and the business matures toward tighter reporting and audit requirements, this system moves from important to load-bearing.
 We're a small, high-trust, high-autonomy team. We give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we hold a high bar on both execution and written communication.
 What You'll Do
 Own the double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles licensing into daily revenue recognition — its accounting model, its invariants, and its correctness guarantees under concurrency, retries, and failure.
 Design and lead the systems behind upmarket licensing: pay-as-you-go metering and billing, fixed-term commitments, and the packaging our enterprise customers buy.
 Build reconciliation and controls that let Finance close the books daily and let auditors trace any recognized dollar back to its source — with the auditability, immutability, and lineage a maturing company requires.
 Partner with Finance, Accounting, Revenue, and Product to turn revenue-recognition policy (ASC 606, deferred revenue, contract modifications, true-ups) into precise, testable system behavior.
 Lead major features end-to-end and bring others along — through design reviews, code reviews, crisp written docs, and direct mentorship.
 Drive operational rigor: strong observability, tight SLOs, low pager noise, and blameless learning when incidents occur.
 Help shape the platform's roadmap toward the company's biggest long-term bets as Verkada scales and matures.
 What You Bring
 8+ years building backend services with strong correctness, consistency, and durability guarantees at scale.
 Depth in financial or transactional systems: ledgers, double-entry accounting, billing, payments, or revenue recognition — you understand why idempotency, exactly-once semantics, immutability, and reconciliation matter, and you've built for them.
 Comfort working shoulder-to-shoulder with Finance and Accounting — or a track record of getting deep in an unfamiliar, high-stakes domain fast.
 Fluency in Python or Go; other backend languages can contribute to your experience, but the interviews will be conducted in one of the above.
 A track record of partnering with Finance, Accounting, or other non-engineering stakeholders, translating policy and ambiguity into systems they can rely on without surprise.
 At the Staff level: the ability to set technical direction across teams, shape shared architecture, and raise the bar on how the org designs and operates critical financial systems.
